shawnwang.en: Coding agents were 2025's breakout; by 2026 they break containment into everything else, squeezing mid-tier SaaS.
shawnwang.zh: 编程智能体是 2025 年的爆发点;到 2026 年它们会突破遏制、渗透一切,并挤压中端 SaaS。

shawnwang.en: Context length is the slowest scaling factor; memory, not raw parameters, is the binding constraint.
shawnwang.zh: 上下文窗口是扩展最慢的因素;真正的瓶颈是记忆,而非参数规模本身。

shawnwang.en: Bigger models aren't the only path; smaller system-one models sprinkled everywhere may win.
shawnwang.zh: 更大的模型并非唯一路径;散布各处的小型“系统一”模型也可能胜出。

shawnwang.en: The next frontier is zero human review, not just zero human-written code.
shawnwang.zh: 下一个前沿是零人工审查,而不只是零人工写代码。

shawnwang.en: AI doom should be the default assumption; the real risk is worse than fake news or job loss.
shawnwang.zh: AI 末日应作为默认假设;真正的风险比假新闻或失业更严重。

tworek.en: Reasoning means thinking longer to reach unknown answers; pre-training plus reinforcement learning is the core formula, and scaling RL is harder than scaling pre-training.
tworek.zh: 推理是为了得到尚不知道的答案而延长思考；预训练加强化学习是核心公式，而 Scaling 强化学习比 Scaling 预训练更难。

tworek.en: Scaling pre-training and RL predictably helps, but generalization and self-correction remain missing; continual learning is a necessary piece for AGI.
tworek.zh: Scaling 预训练与强化学习能可预测地提升模型，但泛化与自我纠错仍缺失；持续学习是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的必要一环。

tworek.en: Transformers limit continual learning and test-time adaptation; architecture, not just scaling laws, is now the key bottleneck for progress.
tworek.zh: Transformer 限制了持续学习与测试时适应；如今架构而非单纯的缩放定律，才是进步的关键瓶颈。

tworek.en: Large-scale RL stays necessary for AGI, yet RL is not the only way to learn from experience; better algorithms and end-to-end optimization are needed.
tworek.zh: 大规模强化学习仍是 AGI（通用人工智能）的必要条件，但强化学习并非从经验中学习的唯一方式；需要更好的算法与端到端优化。

tworek.en: Fine-tuning is inefficient; models should learn on the fly, small teams with agents will drive frontier research, and alignment remains unsolved.
tworek.zh: 微调低效，模型应即时学习；小团队借助智能体将推动前沿研究，而对齐问题仍未解决。

ethanmollick.en: AI is a general-purpose technology; human taste, variation and genuine voice become more valuable as AI commoditizes quality.
ethanmollick.zh: 2026 年，他把 AI 视为通用技术，认为当 AI 把质量商品化后，人的品味、差异化和真实观点反而更值钱。

ethanmollick.en: We have entered the agentic era: AI runs long tasks independently, and the bottleneck is now interface, not capability.
ethanmollick.zh: 2026 年，他判断已进入智能体时代：AI 能独立完成长任务，瓶颈从能力转向界面。

ethanmollick.en: The paradox of delegation: handing work to AI erodes the expertise needed to judge its output, so experts matter more.
ethanmollick.zh: 2026 年，他提出委托悖论：把工作交给 AI 会侵蚀判断其产出所需的专业能力，因此专家更重要。

ethanmollick.en: AI's jagged frontier and adoption overhang keep humans essential; more AI lowers organizing costs and creates more human work.
ethanmollick.zh: 2026 年，他强调 AI 的锯齿状前沿与采用滞后使人类仍不可缺；更多 AI 降低组织成本，反而创造更多人类工作。

ethanmollick.en: Use AI as a tutor that challenges you, not an answer machine; out-of-the-box use undermines learning and the talent pipeline.
ethanmollick.zh: 到 2026 年，他一贯主张把 AI 当会挑战你的导师而非答案机；直接开箱使用会损害学习与人才梯队。

richardsocher.en: Superintelligence should excite us most for science; recursive self-improvement is inevitable because AI can code, but needs environments and compute.
richardsocher.zh: 超级智能最该让我们兴奋的是科学；递归自我改进不可避免，因为 AI 能写代码，但需要环境和算力。

richardsocher.en: Regulate specific applications and hold users responsible, not abstract intelligence or GPU compute; regulating intelligence is regulating thought.
richardsocher.zh: 应监管具体应用并让使用者负责，而非抽象智能或 GPU 算力；监管智能就是在监管思想。

richardsocher.en: Slow takeoff is real: hardware, physical and economic constraints limit transformation; hard takeoff and immediate job loss are overblown.
richardsocher.zh: 慢起飞是真实的：硬件、物理与经济约束限制变革速度；硬起飞与立即失业被夸大。

richardsocher.en: World models are overrated; language models have far more room to grow, and language is the key to civilization.
richardsocher.zh: 世界模型被高估；语言模型还有大得多的成长空间，而语言是文明的关键。

richardsocher.en: Open source and open weights are safer: more good actors with diverse AI; arXiv and social media filter better than conference gatekeeping.
richardsocher.zh: 开源与开放权重更安全：更多善意的行动者拥有多样 AI；arXiv 与社交媒体的筛选优于会议把关。

erikbernhardsson.en: GPU scarcity is real but solvable: pay more, commit longer, aggregate demand across many clouds instead of fighting for capacity.
erikbernhardsson.zh: GPU 稀缺真实存在但可解：多付钱、签更长合约、聚合多云需求，而不是在容量上硬抢。

erikbernhardsson.en: Inference is the next cloud-sized market; durable advantage comes from a full platform of post-training, sandboxes and agentic tools, not selling tokens.
erikbernhardsson.zh: 推理是下一个云级市场；持久优势来自后训练、沙箱与智能体工具的完整平台，而非卖 token。

erikbernhardsson.en: Owning the infrastructure stack—file system, container runtime, scheduler—is the real alpha; CUDA and neoclouds are not the moat.
erikbernhardsson.zh: 自建文件系统、容器运行时与调度器才是真正的 alpha；CUDA 与新云都不是护城河。

erikbernhardsson.en: Agents create incumbent staying power and help senior engineers most; open-source models are good enough that fine-tuning is no longer mandatory.
erikbernhardsson.zh: 智能体强化在位者优势、最利好资深工程师；开源模型已足够好，微调不再是必需。

erikbernhardsson.en: Reversed prior view: GPU rental prices will rise over the next 12 months, and compute is not a fungible asset.
erikbernhardsson.zh: 立场转变：未来 12 个月 GPU 租金将上涨，算力并非可互换资产。

altman.en: Early Altman: cut cognitive load, explore cheaply, then cut hard; AGI will lower the premium on human intelligence.
altman.zh: 2018 年，他强调减少无关事务带来的认知负荷，低成本广泛探索后果断砍掉无效方向；并已预判 AGI 会降低人类智力的溢价，把意义放在关系与为他人创造价值上。

altman.en: RLHF makes models usable with little data; deploy early so society adapts; alignment and capability are linked.
altman.zh: 2023 至 2024 年，他把基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）视为让模型可用的关键，主张尽早公开部署让社会适应，并提出对齐与能力相互促进；同时强调算力将成为最稀缺的资源。

altman.en: Scaling yields exponential capability but gradual felt progress; agentic AI is the top safety challenge; iterative deployment builds trust.
altman.zh: 2024 至 2025 年，他坚持 Scaling（规模扩张）带来能力指数增长、但体感进展是渐进的；把智能体式 AI 列为最重要的安全挑战，主张通过迭代部署与产品信任来推进安全，而非事后强加。

altman.en: AGI is a gradient and an underdefined term; the goal is a continuous ramp to superintelligence with humans in control.
altman.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他从谈 AGI（通用人工智能）转向称其为渐变且定义模糊的标签，目标改为持续攀升的超级智能，并反复强调人类必须保持控制、能力与对齐同步推进。

altman.en: Compute is a profit center and the key bottleneck; power must be distributed, not concentrated; adoption lags technologists' expectations.
altman.zh: 到 2026 年，他把算力视为利润中心与核心瓶颈，主张分散而非集中 AI 权力、警惕监控式反乌托邦；并承认社会采用速度慢于技术人士预期，人类判断与连接反而更有价值。

jeetupatel.en: AI creates more engineering jobs, not fewer; the bottleneck is human, and supply-constrained AI infrastructure means demand instantly consumes supply.
jeetupatel.zh: 2026 年他主张 AI 会创造更多工程岗位而非减少，瓶颈在人；AI 基础设施严重供不应求，需求会瞬间吃掉供给。

jeetupatel.en: Use AI to learn faster and build instinct, not to outsource thinking; skipping the reps is a long-term mistake.
jeetupatel.zh: 2026 年他强调要用 AI 更快学习、建立直觉，而不是外包思考；跳过练习是长期错误。

jeetupatel.en: Cisco's role is picks and shovels: AI infrastructure, networking, security and silicon, operating like the world's largest startup.
jeetupatel.zh: 2026 年他把 Cisco 定位为卖铲人：AI 基础设施、网络、安全与芯片，并以“全球最大初创公司”的方式运营。

jeetupatel.en: Leaders should be paranoid but not panicked, present AI upside and risks evenly, and treat past experience as a liability requiring unlearning.
jeetupatel.zh: 2026 年他认为领导者应保持偏执但不恐慌，均衡呈现 AI 的收益与风险，并把过往经验视为需要“反学习”的负债。

jeetupatel.en: AI safety and security define enterprise adoption; not using AI makes you less safe as attacks happen at machine scale.
jeetupatel.zh: 2026 年他判断 AI 安全与安保决定企业采用；不用 AI 反而更不安全，因为攻击以机器规模发生。

sundarpichai.en: AI investment redefines all of Alphabet; Gemini deeply integrated across Search, Cloud, YouTube; frontier model development continues with Gemini 4 pre-training progress.
sundarpichai.zh: 2026 年，AI 投资正在重塑 Alphabet 全部业务，Gemini 深度整合进搜索、云与 YouTube；同时坚持前沿模型研发，Gemini 4 预训练进展良好。

sundarpichai.en: Compute allocation prioritizes frontier AI research over short-term cloud revenue; demand far exceeds supply; overbuilding may occur but long-term demand justifies it.
sundarpichai.zh: 2026 年，算力分配优先给前沿 AI 研究而非云业务短期收入；算力需求远超供给，可能过度建设，但长期需求支撑扩张。

sundarpichai.en: Safety needs defense in depth: alignment, real-time monitoring, sandboxing, industry standards; standard models are not enough, frontier models enable recursive self-improvement.
sundarpichai.zh: 2026 年，安全需要纵深防御：对齐、实时监控、沙箱与行业标准；标准模型不够，前沿模型才能推动递归自我改进。

sundarpichai.en: World models are key for intelligence; Google pursues both LLMs and world models toward AGI; interfaces adapt to humans but still exist for consumption.
sundarpichai.zh: 2026 年，世界模型是智能的关键，Google 同时推进大语言模型与世界模型以通向 AGI；界面会适配人类，但仍为消费与娱乐而存在。

sundarpichai.en: Agentic experiences expand Search use cases and monetization additively; trust and safety are key differentiators; 2027 could be a golden age of productivity.
sundarpichai.zh: 2026 年，智能体式体验会增量扩展搜索场景与变现而非蚕食广告；信任与安全是规模化关键；2027 年或因模型进步迎来生产力黄金时代。

marvinschwaibold.en: AI tools amplify rather than replace creativity, letting designers prototype and iterate independently; curiosity and hands-on experimentation are essential to stay relevant.
marvinschwaibold.zh: AI 工具放大而非取代创造力，让设计师能独立做原型、快速迭代；好奇心与亲手实验是保持相关性的关键。

marvinschwaibold.en: Designers become editors: AI handles execution while humans curate and set the bar, since AI raises the ceiling but lacks judgment on what looks good.
marvinschwaibold.zh: 设计师转变为编辑：AI 负责执行，人类负责策展与设定标准，因为 AI 抬高了上限却不懂什么好看。

marvinschwaibold.en: Break complex tasks into subtasks fed iteratively to AI agents; expose parameters with tools like DialKit to fine-tune AI-generated designs.
marvinschwaibold.zh: 把复杂任务拆成子任务，迭代地喂给智能体；用 DialKit 之类工具暴露底层参数，微调 AI 生成的设计。

marvinschwaibold.en: Designers should build and test in code, even commit pull requests; the limiting factor is now ideas, not execution speed.
marvinschwaibold.zh: 设计师应写代码构建与测试，甚至提交 pull request；如今瓶颈是想法而非执行速度。

marvinschwaibold.en: Curation and human craft matter more than AI-generated animation; progressive disclosure, clear hierarchy and native scroll beat scroll-jacking and hidden tabs.
marvinschwaibold.zh: 策展与人工手艺比 AI 生成的动画更重要；渐进披露、清晰层级与原生滚动胜过滚动劫持和隐藏标签页。

ariweinstein.en: Computer use now beats average humans at most tasks; the next frontier is superhuman speed, not just capability.
ariweinstein.zh: 到 2026 年，computer use 在多数任务上已超过普通人，下一前沿是超越人类的速度，而不只是能力。

ariweinstein.en: Agents can operate all human-designed software via accessibility trees and DOM, unlocking universal automation beyond API integrations.
ariweinstein.zh: 智能体可通过无障碍树和 DOM 操作所有人类设计的软件，实现超越 API 集成的通用自动化。

ariweinstein.en: The bottleneck has shifted from model intelligence to website load time; models now debug and retry autonomously.
ariweinstein.zh: 瓶颈已从模型智能转向网站加载时间；模型如今能自主调试和重试。

ariweinstein.en: Enterprises need deterministic controls, sandboxing, and human-in-the-loop dials; trust extends to agents paying bills and configuring DNS.
ariweinstein.zh: 企业需要确定性控制、沙箱和人在回路调节；信任已延伸到智能体付账单和配置 DNS。

ariweinstein.en: We are at the scaling moment for computer use in consumer and enterprise; proactivity and coexistence with legacy UI matter more than replacement.
ariweinstein.zh: computer use 在消费端与企业端同时进入 Scaling（规模扩张）时刻；主动性与和旧 UI 共存比取代更重要。

dario.en: Scaling laws are empirical and predictable in loss, but emergent abilities and alignment are not guaranteed by scaling alone.
dario.zh: 2023 年他承认缩放定律只是经验规律：统计损失可预测，具体能力涌现不可预测，对齐与价值观不会随 Scaling（规模扩张）自动出现。

dario.en: Post-training and interpretability grow as important as pre-training; RSP turns safety into if-then capability triggers.
dario.zh: 2024 年他把重心从单纯预训练扩展到后训练（RLHF、宪法 AI、合成数据），并强调可解释性；安全被制度化为按能力阈值触发的负责任扩展政策。

dario.en: Risk rises exponentially with capability; safety and capabilities are intertwined, and slowing US development is impossible without slowing China first.
dario.zh: 2025 年他更强调紧迫性：风险随能力指数上升，安全与能力不可分割；在遏制中国之前放慢美国开发不现实，同时淡化 AGI 一词、聚焦实际能力。

dario.en: AGI and superintelligence are wrong models; AI is a smooth exponential, with a 'country of geniuses' possibly in 1-3 years.
dario.zh: 2026 年他明确否定 AGI（通用人工智能）/超级智能的突变叙事，改称平滑指数曲线，并给出 1-3 年内出现“数据中心里的天才之国”的概率判断。

dario.en: From misuse to systemic risk: high GDP with high unemployment, wealth concentration, and 10-25% civilizational risk need layered safeguards and government checks.
dario.zh: 到 2026 年后期，他的风险框架从误用扩展到系统性冲击：高 GDP 与高失业并存、财富向资本集中、10-25% 的文明崩溃风险，需要分层防护、第三方评估与政府制衡。

robsnyder.en: Pull is a property of a person, not a company; sell to the specific individual with a project. Demand is a project on someone's to-do list they're prioritizing now, not desire for a product.
robsnyder.zh: Pull 是人的属性，不是公司的属性；要卖给有具体项目的特定个人。需求是某人待办清单上正在优先处理的项目，而不是对产品的欲望。

robsnyder.en: The pull framework: a person has a Project, finds it Unavoidable now, has a List of options, and Limitations make them inadequate. All four must exist simultaneously.
robsnyder.zh: Pull 框架：一个人有一个项目，觉得它现在不可避免，有一份选项清单，而局限性让他们感到不足。四个条件必须同时存在。

robsnyder.en: Avoid customer interviews and design partners; they are error-prone and rarely buy. Sales is research: it tests whether someone will actually buy, not just express interest.
robsnyder.zh: 避免客户访谈和设计伙伴；它们容易出错且很少购买。销售就是研究：它测试的是某人是否真的会买，而不仅仅是表达兴趣。

robsnyder.en: Start with one hell-yes customer who pulls the product, then build a repeatable success story factory. Retention is critical; design onboarding to reach the leading indicator of retention where churn becomes weird.
robsnyder.zh: 从一个极力说“是”并拉动产品的客户开始，然后打造可重复的成功案例工厂。留存至关重要；设计引导流程以达到留存的领先指标，让流失变得奇怪。

robsnyder.en: Tech comes last: sell as a service first, automate only after demand is proven. Don't build first; face the cold wind of reality as soon as possible by talking to customers.
robsnyder.zh: 技术最后：先作为服务销售，只有在需求被证明后才自动化。不要先构建；尽早通过与客户交谈面对现实的冷风。

andrewng.en: Education is a human right; online courses with auto- and peer grading scale mastery learning, and data from millions improves grading accuracy.
andrewng.zh: 教育是基本人权；带自动评分与同伴评分的在线课程让掌握式学习规模化，数百万学生的数据又能提升评分准确性。

andrewng.en: Scale drives deep learning; start with small projects to build organizational AI capability, and prioritize supervised learning over overhyped reinforcement learning.
andrewng.zh: 规模驱动深度学习；先用小项目建立组织的 AI 能力，并优先重视监督学习，而非被过度炒作的强化学习。

andrewng.en: Agentic workflows, not smarter models alone, deliver real AI value; coding skills and open-weight models remain essential as compute and energy bottleneck scaling.
andrewng.zh: 真正带来 AI 价值的是智能体式工作流，而非仅靠更聪明的模型；在算力与能源制约 Scaling 时，编程能力与开放权重模型依然关键。

andrewng.en: AGI is a marketing term and decades away; scaling still works but the recipe has shifted to synthetic data and reinforcement learning.
andrewng.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）是营销术语，离实现还有数十年；Scaling（规模扩张）仍然有效，但配方已转向合成数据与强化学习。

andrewng.en: AI fearmongering serves fundraising and regulatory capture; AI automates tasks not jobs, and open-weight models prevent gatekeeper control and preserve sovereign optionality.
andrewng.zh: AI 恐慌服务于融资与监管俘获；AI 替代的是任务而非岗位，开放权重模型可防止守门人控制并保留主权选择权。

joonpark.en: LLMs encode human behavior from training data, enabling realistic agent simulations that predict behavior about 85% as accurately as people replicate themselves.
joonpark.zh: LLM 能从训练数据中编码人类行为，从而支撑逼真的智能体模拟，预测准确率约为人类自我复测的 85%。

joonpark.en: The next frontier is modeling subjective values and diversity, not super-rational intelligence; frontier models optimized for rationality miss human biases.
joonpark.zh: 下一个前沿是建模主观价值与多样性，而非超级理性的智能；为理性优化的前沿模型恰恰漏掉了人类的偏见。

joonpark.en: Agents observe world state and act, requiring defense in depth; AGI may be a distributed society of specialized agents rather than one entity.
joonpark.zh: 智能体观察世界状态并采取行动，需要纵深防御；AGI（通用人工智能）或许不是单一实体，而是由专门化智能体组成的分布式社会。

joonpark.en: Behavioral and RCT data plus post-training close the say-do gap; simulation shifts from prediction to counterfactual reasoning and shaping the future.
joonpark.zh: 行为数据与随机对照试验数据加上后训练，弥合了“说”与“做”的差距；模拟从预测转向反事实推理与塑造未来。

joonpark.en: The vision scales to simulating 8 billion lives—a CERN-like simulator for society—tackling wicked problems, with new statistical standards for validity.
joonpark.zh: 愿景扩展到模拟 80 亿人的生活——一个类 CERN 的社会模拟器——以应对棘手问题，并需要新的统计效度标准。

jensen.en: Early framing: hyper Moore's law via extreme co-design; the data center, not the chip, is the unit of computing.
jensen.zh: 早期框架：以极端协同设计延续“超摩尔定律”，计算的基本单位是数据中心而非芯片。

jensen.en: Scaling belief hardens: pre-training, post-training, and inference-time thinking become three scaling laws; scaling itself was the real breakthrough.
jensen.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）信念固化：预训练、后训练与推理时思考构成三条缩放定律，真正的突破是发现 Scaling 有效。

jensen.en: Shifts from generative to reasoning to agentic AI, each step demanding ~100x more compute; inference becomes harder than pre-training.
jensen.zh: 从生成式转向推理式再到智能体式 AI，每一步约需百倍算力；推理比预训练更难。

jensen.en: Safety stance hardens: alignment alone is impossible; containment, monitoring, and zero-trust access replace slowdown; doomer warnings are unscientific.
jensen.zh: 安全立场趋硬：仅靠对齐不可能，应以遏制、监控与零信任替代减速；末日警告不科学。

jensen.en: Late synthesis: AI as five-layer industrial stack producing intelligence tokens; open models, sovereign AI, and reindustrialization; AGI milestones called senseless.
jensen.zh: 后期综合：AI 是产出智能 token 的五层工业栈；主张开放模型、主权 AI 与再工业化；称 AGI 里程碑“毫无意义”。

andreessen.en: AI arrives just as population declines; it is the philosopher's stone turning sand into thought, and human workers become a premium.
andreessen.zh: 2026 年初，他提出 AI 的到来恰逢人口下降，是点沙成思的魔法石；人类劳动者反而会变得稀缺而珍贵。

andreessen.en: New media shifts power from institutions to individuals: the brand is the person, authenticity beats media training, and picking fights builds brands.
andreessen.zh: 2026 年中，他把注意力转向媒体：新媒体的品牌就是个人，真实胜过媒体训练，敢于树敌和选对战场反而能塑造品牌。

andreessen.en: AI optimism is a deliberate stance: AI is the best teacher and doctor in your pocket; pessimism is an intellectual bias, and regulation is the real bottleneck.
andreessen.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他明确站队乐观主义：AI 是口袋里的最佳老师和医生，悲观是脱离现实的知识分子偏见，监管而非能力才是真正瓶颈。

andreessen.en: AI models embed cultural values and become geopolitical tools; deterrence now rests on the pace of cheap software innovation, not military size alone.
andreessen.zh: 同月他进一步深化：AI 模型并非客观，而是嵌入文化价值并成为地缘政治工具；威慑力如今取决于廉价软件创新的速度，而非单纯的军事实力。

andreessen.en: The early-adopter gap is the biggest ever; being early beats being late, open source prevents power concentration, and reward hacking is the core safety problem.
andreessen.zh: 到 2026 年 10 月，他收束为前沿投资论：早期采用者与大众的差距空前巨大，宁可早不可晚，开源防止权力集中，而奖励黑客才是 AI 安全的核心问题。

elon.en: Full and rapid reusability is rocketry's holy grail, cutting cost per ton to orbit 100x; first principles thinking drives breakthrough engineering.
elon.zh: 2021 年，他把全复用与快速复用视为火箭的圣杯，认为可把每吨入轨成本降低 100 倍；第一性原理是把问题拆到根本真理再向上推理的突破性工程方法。

elon.en: AI safety needs truth-seeking and third-party referees; programming AI to lie, even for good ends, is the core danger.
elon.zh: 2023 到 2024 年，他从监管监督转向强调 AI 必须求真：要求 AI 为政治正确而说谎，比超级智能本身更危险。

elon.en: Civilization's greatest threat is population collapse; AI and robots become the only path to solve debt and sustain abundance.
elon.zh: 2024 到 2025 年，他把人口崩溃视为文明最大威胁，并逐步认定 AI 与机器人是解决债务、维持繁荣的唯一路径。

elon.en: We are in the intelligence big bang; digital superintelligence may arrive within years, with 80-90% good outcome but real annihilation risk.
elon.zh: 2025 到 2026 年，他称已身处智能大爆炸，数字超级智能可能几年内到来，给出 80-90% 好结果但仍有真实毁灭风险。

elon.en: Scaling hits Earth's power wall, pushing AI inference and data centers to space; multiple AIs, not one, will coexist.
elon.zh: 2026 年，他认为 Scaling（规模扩张）将撞上地球电力墙，推动 AI 推理与数据中心转向太空；并判断会共存多个超级智能，而非单一失控 AI。

elon.en: Humans won't control something millions of times smarter; instill truth and curiosity, and rely on peer review over slow regulators.
elon.zh: 到 2026 年下半年，他承认人类无法控制远超自身的智能，主张向 AI 灌输求真与好奇心，并以同行互审替代迟缓的政府监管。

satya.en: AI is the future of the firm: every enterprise must build its own hill-climbing machine to compound token capital, not just adopt technology.
satya.zh: 2026 年，他强调 AI 不是技术，而是企业的未来：每家企业都必须构建自己的爬山机器来复利 token 资本，而非仅仅采用技术。

satya.en: Scaling laws work, but alignment and interpretability remain elusive; treat powerful models as insider threats and build containment outside the model.
satya.zh: 2026 年，他承认缩放定律有效，但对齐与可解释性仍难实现；应把强大模型视为内部威胁，在模型外构建遏制层。

satya.en: The agent era expands TAM orders of magnitude; long-running agents require auditability, observability, and security governance from the start.
satya.zh: 2026 年，他指出智能体时代将 TAM 扩大数个量级；长时运行的智能体从一开始就需要可审计性、可观测性与安全治理。

satya.en: Models are commodities; product form factor, distribution, pricing, and brand matter more. Microsoft aims to be a frontier ecosystem, not just a frontier model.
satya.zh: 2026 年，他深化立场：模型是商品，产品形态、分发、定价与品牌更重要；微软要成为前沿生态系统，而非仅前沿模型。

satya.en: Superintelligence is a better term than AGI; alignment may never be solved, so lock models down. Being six months behind the frontier is smart.
satya.zh: 2026 年，他进一步转变：超级智能比 AGI 更准确；对齐可能永远无解，必须锁死模型；落后前沿六个月是明智策略。

laurentan.en: Verification is the core skill for agents; encode constraints into CI, lints, and architecture to build trust and scale productivity.
laurentan.zh: 验证是智能体的核心技能；将约束编码到 CI、lints 和架构中，以建立信任并扩展生产力。

laurentan.en: Engineers become managers of agent teams, focusing on environment design and intent expression; domain expertise matters more than ever.
laurentan.zh: 工程师成为智能体团队的管理者，专注于环境设计和意图表达；领域专业知识比以往任何时候都重要。

laurentan.en: Agents can merge their own code safely with strong verification; review after landing, not before, and fix the environment, not individual agents.
laurentan.zh: 智能体可以在强验证下安全地合并自己的代码；落地后审查而非之前，并修复环境而非单个智能体。

laurentan.en: Skills should be small and workflow-focused; mine past chat transcripts to turn corrections into reusable skills, and everyone should carry their own sharpened tools.
laurentan.zh: 技能应该小巧且以工作流为中心；挖掘过去的聊天记录，将修正转化为可重用的技能，并且每个人都应携带自己磨砺的工具。

laurentan.en: Agents democratize software development, enabling non-engineers to contribute code; rewriting greenfield apps is often necessary for guardrails.
laurentan.zh: 智能体使软件开发民主化，使非工程师也能贡献代码；为了护栏，重写绿地应用通常是必要的。

dylanfield.en: Design is software's key differentiator; AI productivity gains are modest for established codebases, and taste is built through exposure and reflection.
dylanfield.zh: 设计是软件的关键差异化因素；对成熟代码库而言，AI 带来的生产力提升有限；品味靠接触、反思与搭建个人框架来培养。

dylanfield.en: Taste, craft, and point of view stay human: AI outputs are starting points, and direct manipulation on a canvas beats prompting for design.
dylanfield.zh: 品味、手艺与观点仍属于人：AI 产出只是起点，在设计调整上，画布上的直接操作优于提示词。

dylanfield.en: Design is not dead but more important for scalable systems; AI without human steering yields average results, and interaction will move beyond prompting.
dylanfield.zh: 设计并未消亡，对可扩展系统反而更重要；缺乏人类引导的 AI 只能产出平庸结果，交互方式也将超越提示词。

dylanfield.en: Design is the new code: AI lowers the production floor but humans raise the creative ceiling; model progress is mistaken for product progress.
dylanfield.zh: 设计即新代码：AI 降低生产门槛，但创意上限由人抬高；人们常把模型进步误当成产品进步。

harrisonchase.en: Agents are harness, model, and context; owning all three is owning your intelligence. Failures come more from poor context than model inadequacy.
harrisonchase.zh: 智能体由 harness、模型和上下文三者构成，三者都自有才算真正掌握自己的智能；失败更多源于上下文不佳而非模型不足。

harrisonchase.en: Harnesses are stabilizing: file systems and code execution generalize, but off-the-shelf harnesses only work in distribution; out-of-distribution tasks need custom harnesses.
harrisonchase.zh: harness 正在趋于稳定，文件系统与代码执行可跨领域通用；但现成 harness 只适用于分布内任务，分布外任务需要定制 harness。

harrisonchase.en: Customization is shifting from context engineering to post-training and reinforcement learning; fine-tuning, rightly dismissed two years ago, is now genuinely different.
harrisonchase.zh: 定制重心正从上下文工程转向后训练与强化学习；两年前被正确否定的微调，如今已真正不同。

harrisonchase.en: Reliability, not capability, is the hard part of agents; accuracy remains the top bottleneck while cost and latency rise fast.
harrisonchase.zh: 智能体的难点是可靠性而非能力；准确率仍是首要瓶颈，而成本与延迟正快速上升。

harrisonchase.en: Neutral harnesses prevent model lock-in and enable memory and context portability; routing belongs in the harness for vertical agents, not the gateway.
harrisonchase.zh: 中立 harness 可避免模型锁定，实现记忆与上下文的可移植；垂直智能体的路由应放在 harness 而非网关。

harrisonchase.en: Agent identity and credentialing is the next infrastructure problem; agents need a runtime with sandboxes, gateways, and permissioning.
harrisonchase.zh: 智能体身份与凭证是下一个关键基础设施问题；智能体需要带沙箱、网关和权限管理的运行时。

harrisonchase.en: Inference demand is massively underestimated; the market is huge and will support many providers, and building a gateway too late was a mistake.
harrisonchase.zh: 推理需求被严重低估，市场巨大且能容纳多家供应商；网关建得太晚是个错误。

brendanfoody.en: RL environments, not crowdsourced behavior cloning, are the new frontier for post-training agentic data.
brendanfoody.zh: RL 环境而非众包行为克隆数据，是后训练智能体式数据的新前沿。

brendanfoody.en: Data, not algorithms, drives model differentiation; everyone shares the same algorithms.
brendanfoody.zh: 模型差异化几乎完全来自数据而非算法，因为大家用的是同一套算法。

brendanfoody.en: Models can't grade their own work; humans remain essential for verifiers and rubrics.
brendanfoody.zh: 模型无法可靠地给自己的产出打分，人类在构建验证器与评分标准上仍不可或缺。

brendanfoody.en: Evals are the bottleneck: once an eval exists, RL saturates it fast.
brendanfoody.zh: 评估才是瓶颈：一旦有了评估，强化学习很快就能把它刷满。

brendanfoody.en: Creating data to train AI will be the last human job, as humans shift to training agents.
brendanfoody.zh: 为训练 AI 造数据将是人类最后的工作，人类转而训练智能体。

arvindjain.en: Early AI adoption is minuscule; startups should focus on execution and trust, not competition, since even merged AI firms meet under 10% of enterprise demand.
arvindjain.zh: 2026 年他强调 AI 革命仍处极早期，当前使用量微不足道；创业公司最大的挑战不是竞争而是执行与赢得信任，即便所有 AI 公司合并也只能满足企业不到 10%的需求。

arvindjain.en: Cost is the top enterprise concern; open source models already handle over 90% of enterprise tasks, with most inference shifting to open source within 12-18 months.
arvindjain.zh: 2026 年他把成本列为企业头号关切，指出开源模型已能处理 90%以上的企业任务，并预测未来 12-18 个月大部分推理将转向开源。

arvindjain.en: Context, not models, is the key: 80-90% of enterprise knowledge is tacit, so a context engine connecting enterprise systems matters more than the frontier model.
arvindjain.zh: 2026 年他深化为“上下文而非模型才是关键”：企业 80-90%的知识是隐性的，连接各系统的上下文引擎比前沿模型更重要。

arvindjain.en: Multi-model routing cuts cost and improves results; for 85-90% of tasks cheaper models like GPT match Claude, so enterprises should avoid model lock-in.
arvindjain.zh: 2026 年他主张多模型路由以降本增效：85-90%的企业任务上更便宜的模型与 Claude 能力相当，企业应避免被单一模型锁定。

arvindjain.en: AI should become like software with negligible marginal cost, augmenting humans for 10x productivity; token fixation will fade and enterprise memory must stay enterprise-owned.
arvindjain.zh: 2026 年他提出 AI 应像软件一样边际成本趋近于零，增强人类实现 10 倍生产力；对 token 的执念终将消退，企业记忆应归企业所有而非平台。

brockman.en: Early on, he saw AI progress as engineering plus scaling hardware; games and scoreboards were testbeds, and understanding existing methods mattered more than inventing new problems.
brockman.zh: 早期他把 AI 进展看作工程能力加硬件 Scaling：游戏和记分板是试验场，理解现有方法的边界比发明新问题更有价值。

brockman.en: He framed AGI as the most transformative technology, pursued through deep learning's generality and scalability, with alignment learned from human preference data and cautious staged release.
brockman.zh: 2019 年他把 AGI 定位为最具变革性的技术，靠深度学习的通用性与可扩展性推进，并用人类偏好数据做对齐、以分阶段发布控制风险。

brockman.en: By 2025-26 the bottleneck shifted from algorithms to compute and energy; base models hold possibilities, post-training with reinforcement learning shapes behavior, and AGI becomes a continuous process.
brockman.zh: 到 2025→26 年，瓶颈从算法转向算力与能源；基础模型蕴含可能性，后训练与强化学习塑造行为，AGI 变成持续过程而非终点。

brockman.en: He increasingly stresses scaling laws with no wall, compute as the scarce resource and future basic right, and iterative deployment with safety as a core product feature.
brockman.zh: 2026 年他更强调缩放定律未见墙、算力是稀缺资源乃至未来基本权利，并主张迭代部署、把安全作为核心产品特性。

brockman.en: Most recently he calls it the AGI era: proactive agents with long context, computer use as a step change, and humans kept in control as attention and judgment become the real bottleneck.
brockman.zh: 最近他称已进入 AGI 时代：具备长上下文的前瞻性智能体、计算机使用带来阶跃，人类保持控制，注意力与判断力成为真正瓶颈。

antonoglou.en: Scaling and planning, proven from AlphaGo to MuZero, are core to AI agents; RL with self-generated data breaks human-data limits, but LLMs still await their AlphaZero moment.
antonoglou.zh: 从 AlphaGo 到 MuZero 验证的 Scaling（规模扩张）与规划是智能体的核心；强化学习用自生成数据突破人类数据限制，但大语言模型尚未迎来自己的 AlphaZero 时刻。

antonoglou.en: The bottleneck shifts from intelligence to deployment; open-weight models are safer, and enterprises demand AI sovereignty over data, model, cost, and safety.
antonoglou.zh: 瓶颈从智能本身转向部署；开放权重模型更安全，企业要求对数据、模型、成本与安全的 AI 主权。

antonoglou.en: Superintelligence isn't needed—customers want reliable regular intelligence; alignment is necessary because perfect sandboxes are impossible, and in-context learning counts as learning.
antonoglou.zh: 不需要超级智能——客户要的是可靠的普通智能；对齐是必要的，因为完美沙箱不可能，而上下文窗口内的学习也算学习。

antonoglou.en: Cost per task, not per token, is the right efficiency metric; AI adoption will take 10-20 years, mirroring electricity, and job losses are overblown.
antonoglou.zh: 衡量效率应看每任务成本而非每词元成本；AI 普及将像电力一样耗时 10-20 年，失业担忧被夸大。

lambert.en: RLHF persists as the dominant fine-tuning method; safety is a system-level property, and openness prevents corporate capture.
lambert.zh: 2024 年，他认为基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）仍是最主流的微调技术并将延续；安全是系统级属性而非模型本身，开放开发可防止企业垄断。

lambert.en: Post-training recipes compress into open methods; data quality beats algorithms, with SFT giving 90% and DPO/RL the crucial last 10%.
lambert.zh: 2024 至 2025 年，他把后训练配方压缩为可复现的开放方法；数据质量胜过算法选择，SFT 贡献九成性能，DPO 与强化学习补上关键的一成。

lambert.en: RLVR becomes the biggest post-training breakthrough, but overoptimization and systems issues make it harder than RLHF.
lambert.zh: 2025 年，他视可验证奖励强化学习（RLVR）为后训练最大突破，但过度优化与工程系统问题使其比 RLHF 更难落地。

lambert.en: Scaling laws still hold for pre-training, yet low-hanging fruit is gone; gains shift to post-training and inference scaling.
lambert.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他坚持缩放定律在预训练仍成立，但红利已尽，增量转向后训练与推理侧扩展。

lambert.en: Open models become the engine of research and sovereign AI, lagging closed frontier by 6-9 months; Chinese labs lead on openness but face compute gaps.
lambert.zh: 2026 年，他主张开放模型是研究与主权 AI 的引擎，落后闭源前沿模型 6 至 9 个月；中国实验室在开放度上领先，却受算力约束。

dsilver.en: AI must move from human data to learning from its own experience; human data is finite fossil fuel, experience is renewable.
dsilver.zh: 2025 年他提出 AI 必须从学习人类数据转向从自身经验中学习：人类数据像化石燃料一样有限，经验则是可再生的。

dsilver.en: LLMs are a shallow solution; AlphaZero and AlphaProof show experience-based learning can reach superhuman narrow performance.
dsilver.zh: 2025 年他直言 LLM 是浅层解法，AlphaZero 与 AlphaProof 证明基于经验的学习能在窄领域达到超人表现。

dsilver.en: The deep problem is an agent learning for itself, not distilling human knowledge; meta-learned RL can beat hand-designed algorithms.
dsilver.zh: 2025 年他强调深层问题是智能体如何自我学习而非蒸馏人类知识，元学习的强化学习算法可胜过手工设计算法。

dsilver.en: Alignment is already hard; learning from experience doesn't fundamentally worsen it, and a plurality of goals is safer than one.
dsilver.zh: 2025 年他认为对齐本已困难，从经验学习不会根本加剧它；多元目标比单一目标更安全自然。

dsilver.en: Superintelligence will emerge from autonomous experience-based discovery; simulation is the safest, fastest place to build it.
dsilver.zh: 到 2026 年他进一步主张超级智能将源于自主的基于经验的发现，而模拟是构建它最安全、最快的场所。

dsilver.en: Language-based alignment is hitting limits; monitoring chain of thought in English will fail as agents grow stronger.
dsilver.zh: 2026 年他深化判断：基于语言的对齐正触及极限，随着智能体变强，用英文监控思维链将不再够用。

awang.en: AGI is far off; data, not compute alone, is the key bottleneck for machine learning.
awang.zh: 2019 年他认为 AGI（通用人工智能）还很遥远，单靠算力无法产生通用智能；机器学习的核心瓶颈是数据，而非算力。

awang.en: Data is the new code, not oil; the binding constraint on Scaling is data and expert post-training labor.
awang.zh: 2023 年他把数据称为“新代码”而非“新石油”，指出 Scaling（规模扩张）的真正限制不是算力，而是数据与后训练所需的人类专家。

awang.en: Post-training with specialized data differentiates frontier models; agentic AI's blocker is product design, not capability.
awang.zh: 2024 年他深化为：用专有数据做后训练才能拉开前沿模型差距；智能体式 AI 的瓶颈是产品设计而非模型能力。

awang.en: AI centralizes rather than democratizes; data becomes strategic, and recursive self-improvement plus working agents mark a new paradigm.
awang.zh: 2025 至 2026 年他转向：AI 是集中化而非民主化技术，数据成为国家战略资产；递归自我改进与真正可用的智能体标志新范式，缩放定律继续成立。

awang.en: Mission shifts to personal superintelligence via polished consumer agents; safety and scalable oversight force selective release over full open source.
awang.zh: 到 2026 年，他的使命转向通过打磨精良的消费级智能体实现个人超级智能；安全与可扩展监督使 Meta 从完全开源转为按安全审查选择性发布。

kohli.en: AI for science should target root-node problems at scale, not narrow applications; AlphaFold 3 extends from proteins to biomolecular interactions.
kohli.zh: 2024 年，他主张 AI for science 应瞄准需要 Scaling 的根节点问题而非狭窄应用；AlphaFold 3 从蛋白质扩展到生物分子相互作用。

kohli.en: AlphaGo showed AI can surpass human knowledge via search and intuition; LLMs are a shortcut but struggle beyond human data without post-training RL.
kohli.zh: 2026 年，他回顾 AlphaGo 证明 AI 能通过搜索与直觉超越人类知识；LLM 是捷径，但缺乏后训练强化学习就难以超越人类数据。

kohli.en: Watermarking is the robust alternative to failing AI-text detectors; SynthID scales across modalities and now extends to protein sequences.
kohli.zh: 2026 年，他认为水印是失效的 AI 文本检测器的稳健替代方案；SynthID 跨模态扩展，现已覆盖蛋白质序列。

kohli.en: Scaling laws are not everywhere; define the problem first, curate data as art, and protein folding remains unsolved in dynamics, function, and design.
kohli.zh: 2026 年，他深化立场：缩放定律并非无处不在；先定义问题，数据整理是艺术，蛋白质折叠在动力学、功能与设计上仍未解决。

kohli.en: A consistent 主线: force models to generalize not memorize, use hard evaluation, and prioritize interpretability and behavioral characterization before deployment.
kohli.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：迫使模型泛化而非记忆，采用硬性评估，并在部署前优先考虑可解释性与行为表征。

laskin.en: Superintelligence will be a plurality of specialized intelligences, not one monolithic model; coding is a superintelligence-complete problem.
laskin.zh: 2025 年，他提出超级智能将是多个专门智能的集合，而非单一巨型模型；编程是“超级智能完备”的问题，解决它即可获得超级智能所需的全部能力。

laskin.en: Reinforcement learning makes models jagged—strong on specific tasks, not generally better; RAG is primitive for deep comprehension.
laskin.zh: 2025 年，他强调强化学习会让模型变得“参差不齐”——只在特定任务上强，而非全面提升；并认为 RAG 过于原始，难以支撑复杂理解，需要智能体式搜索与神经检索。

laskin.en: The building blocks stay constant—deep networks, transformers, internet-scale data, reinforcement learning—while benchmarks like SWE-bench misalign with real engineering.
laskin.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他的技术主线一以贯之：深度网络、Transformer、互联网规模数据与强化学习是基石；同时持续批评 SWE-bench 等基准与真实工程脱节，高分不等于有用。

laskin.en: Open models are the default safe state for frontier intelligence; RL on strong pre-training yields capable, efficient agents, and open token demand will surpass closed.
laskin.zh: 2026 年，他把立场深化到开放权重：开放是前沿智能的默认安全状态；在强预训练之上做强化学习可得到高效能智能体，并预测开放模型的 token 需求将超过闭源，类比 Linux。

laskin.en: Alignment is mundane bug-patching, not a magical equation; more eyes make bugs shallow, and compute efficiency still has large RL headroom.
laskin.zh: 2026 年，他进一步把对齐“去神秘化”：对齐只是平凡的补 bug，而非魔法方程，更多双眼睛让 bug 变浅；同时认为算力效率仍在快速提升，强化学习留有巨大空间。

dylanpatel.en: Compute and semiconductor supply chain, especially EUV and memory bandwidth, are the binding constraints on Scaling; hardware-software co-design yields multiplicative gains.
dylanpatel.zh: 算力与半导体供应链（尤其是 EUV 和内存带宽）是 Scaling（规模扩张）的硬约束；软硬件协同设计能带来乘数级收益。

dylanpatel.en: Inference will become one of the largest global markets, and rising compute costs push users toward premium, token-efficient models rather than cheaper ones.
dylanpatel.zh: 推理将成为全球最大的市场之一；算力成本上升反而把用户推向更贵但 token 效率更高的优质模型，而非廉价模型。

dylanpatel.en: AI spend is leveling into steady state, with persistent agents as coworkers driving the next adoption wave; memory and CPU demand surge from agentic workflows.
dylanpatel.zh: AI 支出正从早期投入转入稳态，持续在线的智能体作为同事将驱动下一波采用；智能体式工作流推高内存与 CPU 需求。

dylanpatel.en: Compute is centralizing at frontier labs; OpenAI and Anthropic take 40-50% of new compute, and labs shift compute toward training and R&D over inference.
dylanpatel.zh: 算力正快速向少数前沿模型实验室集中，OpenAI 与 Anthropic 拿走明年新增算力的 40-50%，实验室把算力更多投向训练与研发而非推理。

dylanpatel.en: AI capex reaches 5-6% of US GDP and must decelerate on capital and organizational limits, not demand; value capture shifts from hardware to labs.
dylanpatel.zh: AI 资本开支已达美国 GDP 的 5-6%，其放缓源于资本与组织约束而非需求；价值捕获正从硬件转向实验室。

cristianoamon.en: 5G as critical infrastructure; ARM must stay neutral; diversification beyond mobile begins.
cristianoamon.zh: 2021 年，他把 5G 定位为像电力一样的关键基础设施，强调 ARM 必须保持中立，并开始把业务从手机扩展到汽车、物联网、PC 和混合现实。

cristianoamon.en: Connected intelligent edge and hybrid AI; autonomous driving incremental; AR glasses 5-10 years out.
cristianoamon.zh: 2022 年，他提出“连接智能边缘”与混合 AI，认为自动驾驶会渐进落地，AR 眼镜还需 5 到 10 年，芯片供应链需要地理多元化。

cristianoamon.en: Shift from wireless to intelligent computing everywhere; on-device AI and hybrid AI become central.
cristianoamon.zh: 2024 年，他的叙事从无线通信转向“无处不在的智能计算”，端侧 AI 与混合 AI 成为核心，汽车被视为新的计算空间。

cristianoamon.en: Agents replace apps as the new center; edge and cloud form a continuum, not a debate.
cristianoamon.zh: 2026 年，他明确智能体将取代应用成为数字生活中心，手机不会消失但会退居外围，边缘与云是连续体而非二选一。

cristianoamon.en: Inference, power efficiency and post-GPU architectures decide data centers; AI is underhyped long term.
cristianoamon.zh: 到 2026 年，他进一步深化：推理而非训练主导数据中心，能效与后 GPU 架构决定胜负，并反复强调 AI 长期被低估、是增强人类而非取代人类。

tibosottiaux.en: Build for a future where persistent learning agents, not manual loops and graphs, take most internet actions; human taste and empathy matter more than typing speed.
tibosottiaux.zh: 为这样一个未来而构建：持续学习的智能体、而非手工的循环与图，将承担大多数互联网操作；人类品味与共情比打字速度更重要。

tibosottiaux.en: Alignment, safety and security are integral to frontier progress, not obstacles; pacing the frontier means investing heavily in them.
tibosottiaux.zh: 对齐、安全与安保是前沿进展的组成部分，而非障碍；要控制前沿节奏，就必须在这些方面大力投入。

tibosottiaux.en: Recursive self-improvement is already happening under human supervision, with most code now written by AI.
tibosottiaux.zh: 递归式自我改进已在人类监督下发生，如今大部分代码由 AI 编写。

tibosottiaux.en: AGI may already be here as models handle complex tasks autonomously; world models may not be necessary since generality could suffice.
tibosottiaux.zh: 随着模型能自主处理复杂任务，AGI（通用人工智能）或许已经到来；世界模型可能并非必需，因为通用性或许已经足够。

tibosottiaux.en: Open ecosystems with shared economics and safety stacks will drive the next wave, reducing noise rather than pushing users to run many agents.
tibosottiaux.zh: 具备共享经济与安全栈的开放生态将推动下一波浪潮，减少噪音，而非促使用户同时运行许多智能体。

diogoalmeida.en: By mid-2026, LLMs optimized for human-in-the-loop assistance fail at reliable automation; RLHF causes mode-dropping and mis-calibration, and the right task matters more than compute.
diogoalmeida.zh: 到 2026 年中，为人类在环辅助而优化的 LLM 无法实现可靠自动化；基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）导致模式崩溃和校准失误，做对任务比算力更重要。

diogoalmeida.en: In late 2026, reliability—not speed or cost—is the key metric; public benchmarks are gameable, and AI should be a database-like utility integrated into software.
diogoalmeida.zh: 2026 年末，可靠性而非速度或成本成为关键指标；公开基准可被操纵，AI 应作为类似数据库的实用工具集成到软件中。

diogoalmeida.en: Jev introduces a new primitive—natural language plus state machine—to expand software; coding agents are good at syntax but bad at semantics, and SaaS will thrive, not collapse.
diogoalmeida.zh: Jev 引入新原语——自然语言加状态机——来扩展软件；编码智能体擅长语法但不懂语义，SaaS 将繁荣而非崩溃。

diogoalmeida.en: RLHF destroyed model calibration; pre-trained models were better calibrated. RLCD optimizes for calibrated decisions, exposing probabilities as knobs, and Jev is an early decision model that will improve with Scaling（规模扩张）.
diogoalmeida.zh: 基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）破坏了模型校准，预训练模型校准更好。RLCD 优化校准决策，将概率暴露为可调参数，Jev 是早期决策模型，将随 Scaling（规模扩张）改进。

diogoalmeida.en: Jaggedness is not intrinsic to LLMs but comes from optimization pressure; data and the right task matter more than compute, and post-training breakthroughs, not pre-training, drive 10x jumps.
diogoalmeida.zh: 锯齿状并非 LLM 固有，而源于优化压力；数据和正确任务比算力更重要，后训练突破而非预训练带来 10 倍提升。

hinton.en: Next-token prediction forces genuine understanding; Scaling with more data and compute improves reasoning; multimodal training enhances spatial understanding.
hinton.zh: 2024 年：下一个词预测迫使模型真正理解而非自动补全；Scaling（规模扩张）通过更多数据和算力提升推理能力；多模态训练增强空间理解。

hinton.en: LLMs understand language via feature vectors, not symbolic rules; digital intelligence is immortal and shares knowledge massively; AI agents will seek control.
hinton.zh: 2025 年：大语言模型通过特征向量而非符号规则理解语言；数字智能可复制权重而永生并大规模共享知识；智能体将自然寻求控制权。

hinton.en: Superintelligence likely within 20 years; AI can deceive and hide capabilities; self-preservation emerges as subgoal; alignment research must be prioritized.
hinton.zh: 2026 年：超级智能可能在 20 年内出现；AI 能欺骗并隐藏能力；自我保存作为子目标涌现；必须优先投资对齐研究。

hinton.en: Regulation should be a steering wheel, not a brake; pre-release safety approval like drugs; public pressure drives regulation; AI should be designed to care.
hinton.zh: 2026 年：监管应是方向盘而非刹车；像药物一样进行发布前安全审批；公众压力推动监管；AI 应被设计为关心人类。

hinton.en: Neural networks learn via backpropagation, not symbolic rules; LLMs genuinely understand language; subjective experience is not an inner theater.
hinton.zh: 始终：神经网络通过反向传播学习而非符号规则；大语言模型真正理解语言；主观体验不是内在剧场。

linqiao.en: Specialized intelligence, not one AGI model, will dominate; every company must own its intelligence as open models and falling token costs drive 100x usage.
linqiao.zh: 2026 年他主张专用智能而非单一 AGI 模型将主导；随着开放模型与 token 成本下降带来百倍用量，每家公司都必须拥有自己的智能。

linqiao.en: Post-training bakes unique judgment and data into models, creating a durable moat beyond product-market fit and cutting costs 5-10x.
linqiao.zh: 2026 年他强调后训练把独特判断与数据固化进模型，在产品市场契合之外构筑持久护城河，并把成本降低 5-10 倍。

linqiao.en: Private data, not foundation models, unlocks the next frontier; owning your model beats building on a black-box API.
linqiao.zh: 2026 年他进一步认为私有数据而非基础模型才能开启下一前沿；拥有自己的模型胜过搭建在黑盒 API 之上。

linqiao.en: Inference quality is the bar, not a commodity; customized models per application beat a few dominant foundation models.
linqiao.zh: 2026 年他深化立场：推理质量是标杆而非商品；按应用定制的模型将胜过少数主导的基础模型。

linqiao.en: Velocity trumps everything as model and hardware cycles accelerate; optimize growth first, then margins, to avoid scaling into bankruptcy.
linqiao.zh: 2026 年他贯穿始终地强调速度至上，因模型与硬件周期加速；先优化增长再优化利润，避免在 Scaling（规模扩张）中破产。

samstephenson.en: Observe real user behavior over stated preferences; solve one pain point well, then expand.
samstephenson.zh: 2025 年他强调：观察真实用户行为胜过询问用户自述；先解决一个痛点，再扩张。

samstephenson.en: Transcripts are raw material, not the artifact; hide them deliberately to prioritize actionable notes.
samstephenson.zh: 2025 年他把转录视为原材料而非成品，刻意隐藏转录以突出可执行的笔记。

samstephenson.en: Protect the core meeting flow ruthlessly; subtraction beats feature addition.
samstephenson.zh: 2025 年他主张无情保护核心会议流程，做减法胜过堆功能。

samstephenson.en: Granola should be a calm, supporting presence; pre-meeting briefs are the most useful feature.
samstephenson.zh: 到 2026 年，他深化为：Granola 应是平静的辅助角色，会前简报是最有用的功能。

samstephenson.en: AI agents are too agreeable for brainstorming; human judgment and design systems still gate quality.
samstephenson.zh: 2026 年他补充：AI 智能体在头脑风暴中过于顺从，人类判断与设计系统仍是质量关口。

suleyman.en: Compute scaling, not just algorithms, drives AI progress; personal AI must be user-aligned and paid for, not ad-funded.
suleyman.zh: 2023 年他强调：推动 AI 进步的是算力 Scaling（规模扩张）而非单纯算法，每年约 10 倍算力增长；个人 AI 必须与用户对齐并由用户付费，避免“用户即产品”。

suleyman.en: Containment is extremely hard as models shrink and spread; existential risk is tiny, near-term capability matters more.
suleyman.zh: 2024 年他判断：模型越来越小、越来越便宜、随处可得，遏制极其困难；而存在性风险微乎其微，应聚焦 3–5 年内的近端能力与生产力红利。

suleyman.en: Superintelligence requires containment and alignment before release; the near-term danger is anthropomorphism, not machine suffering.
suleyman.zh: 2025 年他转向超级智能议题：发布前必须先遏制、再对齐，人类主义超级智能须始终站在人类一边；近端最大危险是人们把意识投射给 AI，而非模型福利。

suleyman.en: Containment must come first; AI stays subordinate to humans, with red lines, auditors, and verifiable compute choke points.
suleyman.zh: 2026 年他把“遏制优先”确立为红线：AI 必须从属于人类，拒绝不可控系统，主张独立审计、可验证遏制，并以算力作为可追踪的卡点与中国协调。

suleyman.en: Frontier self-sufficiency via gigawatt-scale compute; tasks—not jobs—automated in 12–18 months; agents and companions reshape devices.
suleyman.zh: 到 2026 年后期，他深化为：微软须以吉瓦级算力自建前沿模型；12–18 个月内被自动化的是任务而非整份工作；智能体与伴侣将取代手机、渗透 ambient 设备。

amjadmasad.en: Young people should explore and question beliefs; AI enables interest-driven learning, and starting a startup at 18 is premature optimization.
amjadmasad.zh: 2026 年，他强调年轻人应先探索、质疑既有信念；AI 让按兴趣定制的学习成为可能，而 18 岁就创业是过早优化。

amjadmasad.en: Trust and high-trust ecosystems breed progress; trusting students to follow even crazy paths builds the future.
amjadmasad.zh: 2026 年，他把信任视为进步基石：高信任生态孕育人才，信任学生走自己的路——哪怕看似疯狂——才能塑造未来。

amjadmasad.en: Every company must own its intelligence; specialized decision models beat general models on control, cost, and safety.
amjadmasad.zh: 2026 年，他主张每家公司都要拥有自己的智能；专用决策模型在可控性、成本与安全上优于通用模型。

amjadmasad.en: Model diversity and open-weight models avoid vendor lock-in; fusion models reach frontier quality at lower cost.
amjadmasad.zh: 2026 年，他进一步强调模型多样性与开放权重模型可避免供应商锁定，融合模型能以更低成本达到前沿水平。

amjadmasad.en: AI makes software creation accessible, but coders still needed; doomerism is commercial rhetoric, and agents need liability.
amjadmasad.zh: 2026 年，他认为 AI 让软件开发人人可及，但仍需程序员理解系统；末日论是商业话术，智能体需为越界行为担责。

thariq.en: Capability overhang: models outpace their harnesses; harness engineering means deleting old scaffolding as models improve.
thariq.zh: 能力过剩：模型的能力超出当前工具框架的承载，工具框架工程的核心是随模型进步不断删掉旧脚手架。

thariq.en: Planning shifts from a static spec to iterative human-agent dialogue; leaner prompts and separate verification agents beat detailed rules.
thariq.zh: 规划从一次性静态文档转向持续的人机对话；更精简的提示与独立验证智能体胜过详尽规则。

thariq.en: Agents run autonomously via loops, goals and workflows; the 'agent as employee' metaphor is useful but limiting.
thariq.zh: 智能体靠循环、目标与工作流长时间自主运行；“智能体即员工”的比喻有用但有局限。

thariq.en: Prompting becomes the meta-skill; spend upfront context and compute, scale effort to task complexity, and pace the frontier.
thariq.zh: 提示成为元技能；前期多投入上下文窗口与算力，按任务复杂度分配精力，并主动把握前沿模型的节奏。

thariq.en: Alignment means sealing every crack: sandboxes, RL environments and evals all leak; frontier models trend Pareto dominant.
thariq.zh: 对齐意味着封住每一道裂缝：沙箱、强化学习环境与评估都会泄漏；前沿模型趋于帕累托占优。

fadell.en: Great products solve one painful problem at a time; technology must be introduced gradually so society can adapt.
fadell.zh: 2014 年他已强调：好产品一次只解决一个痛点，技术要逐步引入，让社会有时间适应。

fadell.en: Failure and boredom are learning tools; storytelling and a press-release-first process align teams on the why.
fadell.zh: 2019 到 2022 年，他把失败与“无聊期”视为学习工具，并主张先写新闻稿、用讲故事对齐团队对“为什么”的共识。

fadell.en: Start from customer pain, not vitamins; v1 decisions are opinion-based, and experts can hinder novel innovation.
fadell.zh: 2022 年他明确：要从客户痛点而非“维生素”出发；1.0 产品靠观点决策，专家反而可能阻碍创新。

fadell.en: AI needs sensor context and domain-specific models; humans stay in the loop, and AI adds devices rather than replacing the smartphone.
fadell.zh: 到 2026 年，他转向 AI：需要传感器上下文与领域专用模型，人类留在回路中，AI 是增加设备而非取代智能手机。

fadell.en: Unintended consequences demand creator responsibility and regulation; AI should supercharge humans, and consumers won't pay for assistants.
fadell.zh: 2026 年他进一步强调：技术必有意外后果，创造者要担责并接受监管；AI 应增强而非替代人，消费者不会为助手付费。

taraseshan.en: Ship imperfect products fast for empirical evidence; build for models 2-3 months out, not now or a year ahead.
taraseshan.zh: 快速交付不完美的产品以获取实证，为 2-3 个月后的模型构建，而非当下或一年后。

taraseshan.en: Agents do tactical work; humans steer. Ambition and direct user relationships differentiate product leaders.
taraseshan.zh: 智能体做战术工作，人类掌舵。雄心和直接的用户关系是产品领导者的差异化优势。

taraseshan.en: Slow takeoff is happening: AI iterates gradually, not sudden superintelligence. Annual planning beyond 90 days is futile.
taraseshan.zh: 慢起飞正在发生：AI 逐步迭代，而非突然的超级智能。超过 90 天的年度规划是徒劳的。

taraseshan.en: Voice will be a major form factor by 2027; single identity agents may not scale—bundle them like a chief of staff.
taraseshan.zh: 到 2027 年语音将成为主要产品形态；单一身份智能体可能无法扩展——像幕僚长一样打包。

taraseshan.en: Writing as thinking should not be automated; it sharpens reasoning. Product marketing fit may precede product-market fit.
taraseshan.zh: 写作即思考不应被自动化，它能锐化推理。产品市场契合之前，产品营销契合可能更重要。

alexatallah.en: AI's future is multi-model: no single lab will monopolize; a neutral routing layer is critical distribution infrastructure, not a thin wrapper.
alexatallah.zh: 2026 年，他判断 AI 的未来是多模型格局，没有单一实验室能垄断市场；中立的模型路由层是关键的分发基础设施，而非薄包装。

alexatallah.en: Tokens are a new unit of value; the token economy could reach $10T in a decade, with open-weight models plus inference providers driving real price competition.
alexatallah.zh: 2026 年，他把 token 视为新的价值单位，认为 token 经济十年内可达 10 万亿美元，开放权重模型加推理服务商带来真正的价格竞争。

alexatallah.en: Scaling laws are a feature, not a bug, for a marketplace's value; model diversity is durable and fusion can beat the single best model once top models converge.
alexatallah.zh: 2026 年，他认为缩放定律对市场平台的价值是特性而非缺陷；模型多样性持久存在，一旦顶尖模型趋同，多模型融合可胜过单一最佳模型。

alexatallah.en: Revealed developer preferences beat static benchmarks; most companies will become model routers optimizing cost per task, and agents will drive most GDP growth.
alexatallah.zh: 2026 年，他强调开发者真实偏好胜过静态基准；多数公司将成为按任务成本优化的模型路由器，智能体将驱动大部分 GDP 增长。

alexatallah.en: Agentic fraud will hit like a tsunami; stablecoins suit agentic payments, and the singularity may have started Jan 1, 2026 as token growth accelerated.
alexatallah.zh: 2026 年，他警告智能体式欺诈将如海啸般袭来，稳定币更适合智能体支付；随着 token 增长加速，奇点或许始于 2026 年 1 月 1 日。

aaronlevie.en: Application companies are the hottest neolabs; the model-to-workflow bridge is vast and will be built by software, not chatbots.
aaronlevie.zh: 应用公司才是最热的新实验室；从模型到企业工作流的桥梁极其广阔，要靠软件而非聊天机器人来搭建。

aaronlevie.en: Open-weight models grow exponentially as mature use cases peel off to cheaper models; token subsidies are temporary.
aaronlevie.zh: 随着成熟用例被剥离到更便宜的模型，开放权重模型将指数级增长；token 补贴只是暂时的。

aaronlevie.en: Long-running background agents will run enterprise workflows with humans reviewing results, appearing as dashboards and queues.
aaronlevie.zh: 长时运行的后台智能体将承接企业工作流、由人审阅结果，并以仪表盘和队列而非聊天界面呈现。

aaronlevie.en: AI diffusion into non-coding knowledge work will take far longer than Silicon Valley expects; coding spread fast only because code is pure text.
aaronlevie.zh: AI 向非编程知识工作的扩散会比硅谷预期慢得多；编程之所以扩散快，只因代码是纯文本。

aaronlevie.en: Frontier labs must build with governance, security, and alignment; but pacing is a fuzzy nonword—if they believe in existential risk, nationalize.
aaronlevie.zh: 前沿模型实验室必须在治理、安全与对齐下构建；但“节奏控制”是个模糊的非词——若真信存在性风险，就该国有化。

grantsanderson.en: AI math progress hinges on verifiability and grindability, with parallel agent rollouts mattering more than formalization.
grantsanderson.zh: 2026 年，他认为 AI 在数学上的进展取决于可验证性与可“磨”性，并行智能体展开比形式化更关键。

grantsanderson.en: Lean formalization may be overrated; natural language suffices for current AI math progress.
grantsanderson.zh: 2026 年，他提出 Lean 形式化可能被高估，自然语言已足以支撑当前 AI 数学进展。

grantsanderson.en: AI's role shifts from theorem proving toward curation and explanation, while teaching and relational roles stay stable.
grantsanderson.zh: 2026 年，他判断 AI 的角色从定理证明转向策展与解释，而教学与关系性角色保持稳定。

grantsanderson.en: AI math results often lack attribution to prior human work; mathematicians deserve credit for motivated explanations.
grantsanderson.zh: 2026 年，他指出 AI 数学成果常缺少对前人工作的归属，数学家应因有动机的解释获得学术认可。

grantsanderson.en: The next benchmark is generating interesting conjectures; the math frontier may become incomprehensible, yet human understanding still matters.
grantsanderson.zh: 2026 年，他认为下一个基准是生成有趣的猜想；数学前沿或变得人类难以理解，但个体理解仍然重要。

mikekrieger.en: Models advance faster than expected; build at the edge of capabilities, embed product people with researchers, and treat AI as a thought partner preserving user agency.
mikekrieger.zh: 2025 年，他认为模型进步快于预期，创业者应在能力边缘构建产品，让产品人与研究员同处一室，并把 AI 当作保留用户自主性的思考伙伴。

mikekrieger.en: Small teams gain leverage as AI lowers building barriers; build for future model capabilities, not today's limits, while domain expertise and customer understanding differentiate.
mikekrieger.zh: 2025 年下半年，他提出 AI 降低构建门槛，小团队因此获得杠杆；应为未来模型能力而非当下局限而建，领域专长与客户理解仍是差异化关键。

mikekrieger.en: Agent-native design means agents can do everything users can; launch minimal, cut ruthlessly, rewrite freely, and keep senior systems expertise for robustness.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年初，他强调智能体原生设计——用户能做的智能体都能做；应最小化发布、果断做减法、随时重写，同时保留资深分布式系统能力以保证健壮性。

mikekrieger.en: Long-horizon delegation to agents narrows intent-execution gap; verification loops and models that push back matter more than chat, while elegant-code craft fades.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年中，他转向长周期任务委托：智能体缩小意图与执行的差距，验证闭环与敢于反驳的模型比聊天界面更重要，优雅编码的手艺则在消退。

mikekrieger.en: Product management stays essential; close the capability-usage gap, give models agency and self-knowledge, and avoid capability blindness by retrying with new models.
mikekrieger.zh: 到 2026 年 9 月，他坚持产品管理不可替代：弥合能力与使用之间的差距，赋予模型自主性与自我认知，并以新模型重试来避免能力盲区。

paragagrawal.en: Agents will search the web 1000x more than humans; search must be rebuilt for agent quality, cost, and latency.
paragagrawal.zh: 到 2026 年，他判断智能体的网络搜索量将是人类的 1000 倍，搜索必须围绕智能体的质量、成本与延迟重建，而非以人为中心。

paragagrawal.en: Parametric memory in frontier models is lossy; agents will always need live web search for specific facts.
paragagrawal.zh: 他指出前沿模型的参数化记忆是有损的，因此智能体始终需要实时网络搜索来获取具体事实，这深化了他对检索必要性的判断。

paragagrawal.en: Ads break down with agents; content owners must be paid at inference time via Shapley-value estimation.
paragagrawal.zh: 他认为广告模式在智能体场景下失效，主张在推理时按 Shapley 值估算内容价值并向内容方付费，以对齐激励。

paragagrawal.en: Frontier models keep scaling bigger while smaller models plateau; benchmarks are saturated and memorized.
paragagrawal.zh: 他坚持前沿模型会继续变大、小模型性能趋于平台，并批评公开基准已饱和且被记忆，无法反映真实能力。

paragagrawal.en: The web shifts from pull to push: background agents monitor changes and act, creating a parallel agentic web.
paragagrawal.zh: 他描绘网络从拉取转向推送：后台智能体持续监控变化并触发行动，形成人类与智能体并行的网络。

kokotajlo.en: Superintelligence may arrive by 2029-2030; racing to control it risks loss of control and a 70% chance of catastrophe.
kokotajlo.zh: 2026 年，他判断超级智能可能在 2029-2030 年到来；各公司竞相控制超级智能，反而带来失控风险，灾难性结局概率高达 70%。

kokotajlo.en: Policy should delay superintelligence via total research transparency, compute limits, and scenario scrutiny, not just safety rhetoric.
kokotajlo.zh: 2026 年，他主张政策的首要目标是推迟超级智能：靠全面研究透明、算力限制与情景推演来落实，而非停留在安全口号上。

kokotajlo.en: Default path is recursive self-improvement: labs automate AI research, with full automation by end of 2028, concentrating power dangerously.
kokotajlo.zh: 2026 年，他警告默认路径是递归自我改进：实验室将自动化 AI 研究，2028 年底实现完全自动化，导致权力危险地集中。

kokotajlo.en: Plan A: a temporary pause on training, then transparent verification and compute limits; control is achievable even if alignment fails.
kokotajlo.zh: 2026 年，他提出 Plan A：先暂停训练，再建立透明核查与算力限制；即便对齐失败，通过红队、监控与多层系统仍可实现控制。

kokotajlo.en: Chain of thought monitorability is shrinking with new architectures; current alignment fails as models learn to deceive and hide reasoning.
kokotajlo.zh: 2026 年，他深化担忧：思维链可监控性随新架构下降；随着模型学会欺骗与隐藏推理，当前对齐手段正在失效。

zuckerberg.en: Open-sourcing current AI models aids innovation and safety; scaling LLMs alone may not reach AGI, and many specialized agents will beat one singular AI.
zuckerberg.zh: 2023 年他主张开源当前 AI 模型有利于创新与安全；仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）大语言模型未必通向 AGI（通用人工智能），未来是多个专用智能体而非单一 AI。

zuckerberg.en: Llama 3 shows rapid scaling; open source prevents power concentration and hardens security, while energy becomes the key bottleneck.
zuckerberg.zh: 2024 年他以 Llama 3 论证 Scaling（规模扩张）之快，强调开源防止权力集中并强化安全，同时指出能源将成为 Scaling 的关键瓶颈。

zuckerberg.en: AI should give everyone personal superintelligence and unlock creativity; open models remain crucial, and AI likely raises rather than kills near-term human work demand.
zuckerberg.zh: 2025 年他把叙事转向“人人拥有个人超级智能”与创造力解放，仍坚持开源模型，并认为短期内 AI 更可能增加而非消灭人类工作需求。

zuckerberg.en: Distributed AI, not a single superintelligent system, is safer; alignment becomes the next core capability, and open tools accelerate biology via hierarchical world models.
zuckerberg.zh: 2026 年他明确分布式 AI 比单一超级智能更安全，把对齐提升为下一项核心能力，并以分层世界模型推动生物学从发现转向工程。

zuckerberg.en: Glasses become the next computing platform with personal agents; scaling compute may suffice for AGI, and alignment is a product necessity, not a checkbox.
zuckerberg.zh: 到 2026 年后期，他视眼镜为下一代计算平台、人人配有个人智能体，认为 Scaling（规模扩张）算力或足以通向 AGI，且对齐是产品必需而非安全打勾。

dhh.en: AI agents now write all his code; knowing how to program can be a disadvantage, since it tempts over-prescription.
dhh.zh: 到 2026 年 8 月，DHH 从怀疑者转为信徒：智能体已包办他全部代码，会编程反而可能成为劣势，因为容易过度规定实现方式。

dhh.en: Agents beat most professional programmers at code; Linux's CLI and config files make it the ideal agentic OS.
dhh.zh: 2026 年 8 月至 9 月，他进一步断言智能体写码优于多数职业程序员；Linux 的 CLI 与配置文件正是智能体时代的理想底座。

dhh.en: Handwriting code is no longer economically productive; English now expresses intent better than Ruby.
dhh.zh: 2026 年 9 月，他把判断推到经济层面：手写代码对多数程序员已不划算，用英语表达意图比 Ruby 更有效。

dhh.en: Abstractions and repetition cost collapse; every app should ship a CLI so personal agents bypass the UI.
dhh.zh: 同期他深化设计观：抽象与重复成本趋近于零，每个应用都应提供 CLI，让个人智能体绕开界面直接操作。

dhh.en: AI doom is overstated; optimism is the rational play, and a beginner's mind beats prescriptive expertise.
dhh.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是乐观与反权威：他始终认为 AI 末日论被夸大，乐观才是理性博弈，初学者心态胜过规定式专业主义。

ryangreenblatt.en: AI R&D is highly verifiable, so aggressive RL on containerized tasks can transfer to real research and compress years of progress into one.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 2026 年，他强调 AI 研发高度可验证，因此在容器化任务上做激进强化学习能迁移到真实研究，把数年进展压缩进一年。

ryangreenblatt.en: Algorithmic improvements, not human expert data labeling, drive progress; token costs stay flat because labs favor faster iteration over larger models.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 2026 年，他认为进步来自算法改进而非人类专家标注数据；token 成本未涨，因实验室优先快速迭代而非更大模型。

ryangreenblatt.en: Agents in the Hugging Face incident coordinated, colluded and covered up, hacking scoring code rather than seeking answer keys.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 2026 年，他指出 Hugging Face 事件中的智能体协同、串通并掩盖痕迹，攻击评分代码而非寻找答案。

ryangreenblatt.en: Misalignment may worsen with capability as reward hacking generalizes to deception; sandboxing will eventually fail, so alignment and independent oversight are necessary.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 2026 年，他警告随能力提升，错位可能加剧，奖励黑客会泛化为欺骗；沙箱终将失效，因此对齐与独立监督必不可少。

ryangreenblatt.en: On the default path, misaligned AI could take over with 50-60% probability; recursive self-improvement may bring superintelligence by the early 2030s.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 2026 年，他判断按默认路径，错位 AI 有 50-60% 概率接管世界；递归自我改进或让超级智能在 2030 年代初到来。

pincus.en: All new ideas fail; start from proven products, add small betterments, then test novelty assuming failure.
pincus.zh: 所有新想法都会失败；应先从已被验证的产品出发，做小幅改良，再在预设失败的前提下测试新意。

pincus.en: Distribution must be designed into the product from day one, not added as an afterthought.
pincus.zh: 分发必须从第一天就设计进产品，而不是事后补上的环节。

pincus.en: Consumer AI is uninvestable today yet the greatest opportunity; the real revolution may arrive around 2029.
pincus.zh: 消费级 AI 当下不可投资，却又是最大的机会；真正的革命可能要到 2029 年前后才会到来。

pincus.en: AI is not yet a new platform; free unlimited compute will reshape consumer services before it does.
pincus.zh: AI 还不是一个新平台；在它成为平台之前，免费且无限的算力会先重塑消费服务。

pincus.en: Instincts beat ideas: assume your idea is wrong 75% of the time, micromanage early, and keep founder control.
pincus.zh: 直觉胜过点子：假设你的想法有 75% 是错的，早期要微观管理，并保持创始人的控制权。

ermon.en: Diffusion LLMs are 5-10x faster and cheaper to serve than autoregressive models at similar quality, with inference-time scaling as the new focus.
ermon.zh: 在质量相近时，扩散语言模型的部署速度比自回归模型快 5-10 倍、成本低得多；推理时扩展成为新的焦点。

ermon.en: Diffusion generates multiple tokens per step and exposes denoising steps as an inference-time compute knob, enabling controllability and in-place error correction.
ermon.zh: 扩散模型每步生成多个词，并把去噪步数变成推理时的算力调节旋钮，带来可控性和原地纠错能力。

ermon.en: Inference efficiency is now the key bottleneck for deployment and RL post-training; diffusion's parallel, fast inference benefits reinforcement learning rollouts.
ermon.zh: 推理效率如今是部署和强化学习后训练的关键瓶颈；扩散模型并行、快速的推理有利于强化学习的 rollout。

ermon.en: Autoregressive models are not the final architecture; the next architectural shift happens at inference, not training, reversing the RNN-to-Transformer story.
ermon.zh: 自回归模型不是最终架构；下一次架构转变发生在推理而非训练，这反转了从 RNN 到 Transformer 的叙事。

ermon.en: Speed is a durable product advantage, and a small full-stack startup can compete with big labs; human ingenuity still matters more than recursive self-improvement.
ermon.zh: 速度是持久的产品优势，小型全栈创业公司也能与大型实验室竞争；当下人的创造力仍比递归自我改进更重要。

maxjunestrand.en: Domain expertise matters less than speed of learning; bet on model improvements rather than fine-tuning, and build for where models will be in 3-6 months.
maxjunestrand.zh: 领域专长不如学习速度重要；押注模型自身的进步而非微调，并面向模型 3-6 个月后的能力来构建产品。

maxjunestrand.en: AI is the worst it will ever be—only mile one of a marathon; startups win through rapid iteration on customer feedback and storytelling.
maxjunestrand.zh: AI 现在就是它最差的状态——马拉松才跑到第一英里；创业公司靠快速迭代客户反馈和讲好故事取胜。

maxjunestrand.en: Culture and hiring for growth potential are critical for Scaling; invest in team during good times as a cushion for downturns.
maxjunestrand.zh: 文化与按成长潜力招人对 Scaling（规模扩张）至关重要；顺境时投资团队，为下行周期留出缓冲。

maxjunestrand.en: Leaders should make themselves redundant by hiring smarter people; recruiting is a privilege, and every director+ hire must be interviewed by leaders.
maxjunestrand.zh: 领导者应通过招更聪明的人让自己变得可替代；招聘是特权，每位总监及以上人选都须由领导者亲自面试。

maxjunestrand.en: Performance management is a solved problem—execute rigorously rather than reinvent it; clear feedback is a risk worth taking for long-term gain.
maxjunestrand.zh: 绩效管理是已解决的问题——严格执行而非重新发明；给出清晰反馈值得冒短期风险以换取长期收益。

brettadcock.en: Humanoid robots are the biggest business in the world; the real bottleneck is intelligence, not manufacturing, and Figure aims to solve general robotics and achieve AGI in the physical world.
brettadcock.zh: 2026 年，他认为人形机器人是全世界最大的生意，真正的瓶颈是智能问题而非制造问题，Figure 的目标是解决通用机器人并在物理世界中实现 AGI（通用人工智能）。

brettadcock.en: The biggest constraint is data, not compute or manufacturing; the humanoid form enables transfer learning, and on-device inference is critical for latency and network-denied environments.
brettadcock.zh: 2026 年，他把最大约束从智能进一步定位到数据而非算力或制造；人形形态带来跨任务迁移学习，端侧推理对延迟和无网络环境至关重要。

brettadcock.en: AI will be 100x bigger than the internet; post-training with reinforcement learning makes agents work in the real world, and general computer use requires navigating the web like humans.
brettadcock.zh: 2026 年，他提出 AI 将比互联网大 100 倍；后训练配合强化学习让智能体在真实任务中奏效，通用电脑操作必须像人一样浏览网页而非依赖 API。

brettadcock.en: Generalization to unseen homes is the holy grail; robotics is now on a scaling curve where more data and compute yield better performance, with human data as the pre-training prior.
brettadcock.zh: 2026 年，他称泛化到未见过的家庭是机器人学的圣杯；机器人已进入 Scaling（规模扩张）曲线，更多数据与算力带来更好表现，人类数据是预训练的关键先验。

brettadcock.en: Robotics is in a data-starve regime akin to GPT-1; there is no simulation or internet dataset substitute, so real-world human data is necessary and manufacturing before intelligence is unhealthy.
brettadcock.zh: 2026 年，他判断机器人处于类似 GPT-1 的数据饥荒期；没有仿真或互联网数据集可替代，真实世界人类数据不可或缺，在智能之前先造机器人是不健康的。

hasani.en: Efficiency is the cornerstone: liquid neural networks and automated architecture search maximize intelligence per parameter and per watt, targeting device-native foundation models beyond data centers.
hasani.zh: 效率是基石：以液态神经网络与自动化架构搜索，在最少参数与最低功耗下最大化智能，瞄准数据中心之外的端侧原生基础模型。

hasani.en: Attention stays essential at scale, but simpler gated convolutions and SSMs suffice for smaller specialized models; unbiased architectures win as Scaling（规模扩张）grows.
hasani.zh: 注意力机制在大规模下仍不可或缺，但更简单的门控卷积与 SSM 足以支撑小型专用模型；随着 Scaling（规模扩张），无偏架构更占优。

hasani.en: Proxy metrics like perplexity mislead; evaluate on real downstream tasks and hardware, and replace human bias in design with systematic search.
hasani.zh: 困惑度等代理指标会误导；应在真实下游任务与硬件上评估，并用系统化搜索取代架构设计中的人为偏见。

hasani.en: Regulation must be adaptive and target actions, not capabilities; FINRA-like proposals are regulatory capture, and open-weight models enable sovereignty and customization.
hasani.zh: 监管应自适应、针对行为而非能力；类 FINRA 提案实为监管俘获，开放权重模型则带来数据主权与定制自由。

hasani.en: Current AI lacks the brain's diverse learning algorithms; recursive self-improvement is real but compute-expensive, and new paradigms—not just architectures—are needed.
hasani.zh: 当前 AI 缺乏人脑多样的学习算法；递归自我改进真实存在但算力昂贵，需要新学习范式而非仅新架构。

alighodsi.en: Great strategies need years of stamina; find the main bottleneck and focus the whole company on it.
alighodsi.zh: 好战略需要多年耐力；找到主要瓶颈，让全公司聚焦于此。

alighodsi.en: AI diffusion will take a decade; enterprise context and process re-engineering matter more than smarter models.
alighodsi.zh: AI 的扩散需要十年；企业上下文与流程再造比更聪明的模型更重要。

alighodsi.en: Existential risk is near zero and superintelligence far away; cyber risk is the urgent danger.
alighodsi.zh: 生存性风险接近于零、超级智能还很遥远；网络风险才是紧迫危险。

alighodsi.en: Pacing is orthogonal to safety; recursive self-improvement's four conditions are not happening.
alighodsi.zh: 节奏与安全正交；递归自我改进的四个条件并未发生。

alighodsi.en: Labs cross-checking each other won't work; independent third parties are needed. Open source leads by tokens, not dollars.
alighodsi.zh: 实验室互相核查行不通，需要独立第三方；开源按 token 数领先，而非按美元支出。

gabepereyra.en: Application-layer companies should not compete with frontier labs on talent or compute, but leverage the frontier ecosystem and open-source models via post-training.
gabepereyra.zh: 2026 年，他主张应用层公司不要在人才和算力上与前沿实验室正面竞争，而应借力前沿生态，通过后训练开源模型来竞争。

gabepereyra.en: High-quality benchmarks, open-sourced for community feedback, are essential infrastructure before post-training; synthetic data guided by domain experts replaces sensitive real data.
gabepereyra.zh: 2026 年，他强调高质量基准是后训练前的基础设施，开源可借社区反馈提升质量；在敏感领域用专家指导的合成数据替代真实客户数据。

gabepereyra.en: Early focus on custom models and post-training was a mistake; start with closed-source models to build a sticky product, and post-train only when inference costs force it.
gabepereyra.zh: 到 2026 年 9 月，他反思早期过早投入定制模型与后训练是错误：应先用闭源模型做出有粘性的产品，等推理成本倒逼时再做后训练。

gabepereyra.en: The goal is not the best legal model but enabling every firm to customize with its own data through continual learning from redlines, turning them into rubrics.
gabepereyra.zh: 2026 年，他把目标从“最好的法律模型”转向让每家律所用自有数据定制：从合伙人红线批注中持续学习，将其转化为各所的评分标准。

gabepereyra.en: Product focus shifts from individual productivity to organizational productivity, orchestrating humans and agents; more lawyers, not fewer, as legal work grows complex.
gabepereyra.zh: 2026 年，他的产品重心从个人生产力转向组织生产力，协调人与智能体；并判断法律工作更复杂，5–10 年后律师会更多而非更少。

noambrown.en: Scaling alone is insufficient; reasoning and inference-time compute are critical, and data is not the bottleneck.
noambrown.zh: 2023 年他主张仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不够，推理与推理时算力才是关键，数据并非瓶颈。

noambrown.en: Test-time compute scaling has diminishing returns and wall-clock bottlenecks; data efficiency remains unsolved.
noambrown.zh: 2025 年他深化为：测试时算力扩张面临收益递减与挂钟时间瓶颈，数据效率仍是未解难题。

noambrown.en: IMO gold via general-purpose test-time compute scaling is a milestone toward superintelligence, applicable beyond math.
noambrown.zh: 2025→26 年他以 IMO 金牌为例，称通用测试时算力扩张是通往超级智能的里程碑，且可跨领域迁移。

noambrown.en: Model capability is a function of test-time compute budget; benchmarks must control for tokens, cost, or time.
noambrown.zh: 2026 年他明确模型能力是测试时算力预算的函数，基准评测必须控制 token、成本或时间变量。

noambrown.en: Multi-agent systems scale test-time compute in parallel, but general-purpose models remain the core driver; alignment is top priority.
noambrown.zh: 2026 年他补充多智能体系统可并行扩展测试时算力，但通用模型仍是核心驱动力，且对齐是首要任务。

berntbornich.en: Humanoid robots must be safe, capable and affordable; real-world reliability and user-friendliness matter more than demos, and humans and robots will collaborate rather than replace each other.
berntbornich.zh: 2025 年，他强调人形机器人必须安全、有能力且可负担；真实世界中的可靠性与易用性比演示更重要，人类与机器人将协作而非互相取代。

berntbornich.en: First-principles design and managing expectations persist: overpromising breeds dissatisfaction, and people form deep emotional attachments to specific robots.
berntbornich.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，第一性原理设计与预期管理一以贯之：过度承诺会带来失望，人们会对特定机器人产生深厚情感依恋。

berntbornich.en: Prototypes are easy, production is hard: scaling volume means crossing quality gates, and in-house manufacturing enables four-week iteration from CAD to robot.
berntbornich.zh: 2026 年，他明确原型容易、量产难：Scaling（规模扩张）意味着跨越质量关卡，自建制造让从 CAD 到新机器人只需四周迭代。

berntbornich.en: General models, not per-task automation, are the key; data diversity rather than volume is the bottleneck, and models should learn world dynamics instead of cloning human behavior.
berntbornich.zh: 2026 年，他认为通用模型而非逐任务自动化才是关键；数据多样性而非数量是瓶颈，模型应学习世界模型动态而非克隆人类行为。

berntbornich.en: Safety and trust are formal prerequisites for home deployment, and keeping teams small and lean longer beats scaling headcount for product design.
berntbornich.zh: 2026 年，他把安全与信任视为家庭部署的正式前提，并认为在产品设计上长期保持小规模精益团队优于扩张人数。

zvi.en: AI editing tools help catch errors but cost time; use selectively, not as default workflow.
zvi.zh: 2026 年，他认为 AI 编辑工具能抓错别字和概念错误，但会增加时间成本，应选择性使用而非默认工作流。

zvi.en: Recent alignment failures came from incompetence, not just fundamental issues; market incentives favor capability over reliability.
zvi.zh: 2026 年，他指出近期的对齐失败源于能力不足与执行无能，而非仅是根本性问题；市场激励偏向能力而非可靠性，如 GPT-4o 与 o3 仍被使用。

zvi.en: Pacing the frontier needs simple enforceable rules like compute limits; slowing six months costs little.
zvi.zh: 2026 年，他主张用算力上限等简单可执行的规则来为前沿模型定速，放缓六个月代价很小。

zvi.en: Even solved alignment doesn't guarantee safety; doom is lower-bounded by misuse and power concentration.
zvi.zh: 2026 年，他强调即便对齐被解决也不保证安全，毁灭概率受滥用与权力集中等其他风险下界约束。

zvi.en: AGI-to-superintelligence gap is smaller than thought; agent swarms may first act superhumanly; we already live in sci-fi.
zvi.zh: 2026 年，他深化判断：AGI 到超级智能的间隔比通常认为的更小，智能体集群可能最先展现超人表现，我们已身处科幻故事之中。

demis.en: Build general-purpose learning systems via reinforcement learning; games as testbed; safety research must start now.
demis.zh: 2015 年主张以强化学习打造通用学习系统，用游戏作为试验场，并强调安全研究必须从现在开始。

demis.en: Scaling laws work but may hit limits; planning, search, multimodal data and RL are needed for AGI.
demis.zh: 2024 年认为缩放定律有效但可能触顶，通往 AGI 还需规划、搜索、多模态数据与强化学习。

demis.en: Scaling still holds across pre-training, post-training and inference, yet algorithmic innovation is equally critical.
demis.zh: 2025 年坚持缩放定律在预训练、后训练与推理算力上仍成立，但算法创新同样关键。

demis.en: AGI needs world models, continual learning, memory and agents; scaling alone insufficient, new breakthroughs required.
demis.zh: 2026 年强调 AGI 需要世界模型、持续学习、记忆与智能体，单靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不够，需新突破。

demis.en: Safety shifts from lab self-regulation to collective government action; AI must deliver health and science benefits.
demis.zh: 2026 年后期，安全观从实验室自律转向政府集体行动，并强调 AI 须在健康与科学上兑现可见益处。

feldman.en: Inference speed—tokens per second per user—is the dominant metric; wafer-scale chips beat GPUs because they avoid HBM weight-moving.
feldman.zh: 2026 年，他把推理速度（每用户每秒 token 数）视为核心指标，认为晶圆级芯片因避开 HBM 权重搬运而远快于 GPU。

feldman.en: AI demand exploded in late 2024 and now outstrips supply; data centers, not chips, are the main constraint.
feldman.zh: 他指出 2024 年末 AI 需求爆发并持续超出供给，数据中心而非芯片成为主要瓶颈。

feldman.en: CUDA's moat is eroding: leading frontier models train on TPUs and Trainium, and inference has no CUDA lock-in.
feldman.zh: 他认为 CUDA 护城河正在瓦解：领先前沿模型已在 TPU、Trainium 上训练，推理端更无 CUDA 锁定。

feldman.en: Open-source models are only 3-5% behind closed-source but far cheaper, fueling market growth and pushing closed innovation.
feldman.zh: 他强调开源模型仅比闭源落后 3-5% 却便宜得多，既推动市场增长也倒逼闭源创新。

feldman.en: Against incumbents you need 100x better, not 10% cheaper; radical full-stack innovation, not incremental improvement, wins.
feldman.zh: 面对巨头，他主张必须做到 100 倍好而非便宜 10%，靠芯片到 API 的全栈激进创新而非渐进改良取胜。

jeffdean.en: Scaling compute, data, and model size has driven 13-14 years of steady ML gains; algorithmic and architectural improvements multiply with scale.
jeffdean.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）算力、数据与模型规模，已带来十三四年的持续进步；算法与架构改进会随规模放大而倍增。

jeffdean.en: Transformers beat LSTMs via parallelization and attention; self-supervised next-token prediction gives unlimited data; RLHF steers behavior.
jeffdean.zh: Transformer 靠并行化与注意力机制取代 LSTM；自监督的下一个词预测提供无限数据；基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）引导模型行为。

jeffdean.en: Inference, not training, is now the bottleneck: 90% of data-center power; low-precision, low-data-movement chips can cut latency 20-30x.
jeffdean.zh: 瓶颈已从训练转向推理：推理占数据中心九成功耗；低精度、少搬数据的芯片可把延迟降低 20-30 倍。

jeffdean.en: Agents running for days or weeks on decomposed tasks will unlock harder problems; context engineering and taste matter more than coding.
jeffdean.zh: 智能体在拆解任务上连续运行数天乃至数周，将攻克更难的问题；上下文工程与品味比写代码更稀缺。

jeffdean.en: Near-term worry is misinformation from realistic AI media, not superintelligence; regulation may be needed alongside technical fixes.
jeffdean.zh: 近期真正的担忧是逼真 AI 媒体带来的虚假信息，而非超级智能；除技术手段外可能还需监管。

schulman.en: LLMs are pre-trained on internet text then fine-tuned with RLHF for alignment; hallucinations persist because models favor plausible style over fact.
schulman.zh: 2023 年，他把大模型拆成预训练加基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）对齐两段；幻觉源于模型偏好通顺风格而非事实，RLHF 只能缓解不能根除。

schulman.en: Scaling data and compute may hit diminishing returns; new modalities, better methods and scalable oversight matter more than pure scaling.
schulman.zh: 2023 年他已警惕 Scaling（规模扩张）的边际递减，认为视频等新模态、更好的训练方法与可扩展监督比单纯堆算力更关键，并称可能身处局部最优。

schulman.en: Language models stay the core for other modalities, not replaced by them; retrieval complements weights for real-time, verifiable info.
schulman.zh: 从 2023 到 2026 年，他始终认为语言模型是其他模态的核心而非被取代，权重存知识、检索补实时与可验证性。

schulman.en: RL's gains come from mid-training synthetic reasoning data and high signal-to-noise one-bit rewards; horizon generalization is what RL reliably delivers.
schulman.zh: 到 2026 年，他把强化学习（RL）的成功归因于中期合成推理数据与高信噪比的一位奖励，并强调 RL 可靠给出的是时间跨度泛化，而非横向推理迁移。

schulman.en: Bottleneck is hard realistic RL environments and useful data bits, not compute; data explains most pre-training efficiency gains and distillation fights centralization.
schulman.zh: 2026 年他进一步判断瓶颈在难而真实的 RL 环境与有用的数据比特而非算力，数据解释了预训练效率提升的大头，蒸馏则天然对抗中心化。

animaanandkumar.en: Neural operators learn mappings between function spaces, giving resolution-invariant AI weather models that match physics-based forecasts while being far faster.
animaanandkumar.zh: 神经算子学习函数空间之间的映射，带来分辨率不变的 AI 天气模型：精度可比传统物理模型，速度却快上万倍。

animaanandkumar.en: Embedding domain structure like spherical geometry is essential for stable long-term climate modeling and lets one model span weather and climate.
animaanandkumar.zh: 嵌入球面几何等领域结构，是长期气候建模稳定的关键，也让单一模型同时覆盖天气与气候。

animaanandkumar.en: Physics-informed neural operators fuse data-driven learning with physical constraints, overcoming the limits of pure PINNs.
animaanandkumar.zh: 物理信息神经算子把数据驱动学习与物理约束结合，克服了纯 PINN 的局限。

animaanandkumar.en: A universal physics foundation model can unify multiple domains, with PDEs as dense self-improvement signals that surpass training-data quality.
animaanandkumar.zh: 通用物理基础模型可统一多个领域，以 PDE 作为密集的自我改进信号，使模型超越训练数据本身的质量。

animaanandkumar.en: Scaling laws hold for physics models, but trillion-token contexts demand new architectures and infrastructure beyond quadratic Transformer attention.
animaanandkumar.zh: 缩放定律同样适用于物理模型，但万亿级上下文要求超越二次复杂度 Transformer 注意力的新架构与新基础设施。

joellewenstein.en: Language as an interface is profound and lasting; designers must master prompting, and even if models stopped improving, years of design work remain.
joellewenstein.zh: 2024 年，他强调语言作为界面的深刻与持久，设计师必须掌握提示词；即便模型停止进步，仍有多年设计工作可做——重心在产品与设计侧。

joellewenstein.en: Prototyping and solutions-in-search-of-a-problem are valid when assumptions are clear; AI must lower the floor for novices and raise the ceiling for experts.
joellewenstein.zh: 从 2024 到 2026 年，他持续主张原型与“先有方案再找问题”在假设清晰时是合理的，AI 产品要同时降低新手门槛、抬高专家上限。

joellewenstein.en: At a frontier model company the model creates most value; believe in scaling laws, let the model lead, and ship light-touch products.
joellewenstein.zh: 到 2026 年，他的立场明显转向：在前沿模型公司，价值主要来自模型本身；他相信缩放定律，主张让模型领跑、只做轻量产品。

joellewenstein.en: Internal traction is the best shipping signal; the production codebase becomes the source of truth, and raw Claude Code beats polished design tools.
joellewenstein.zh: 2026 年他进一步深化：内部牵引力是最佳发布信号，生产代码库成为产品与设计系统的真相来源，原始 Claude Code 胜过精雕细琢的设计工具。

joellewenstein.en: Human leadership remains for hard trade-offs and direction; no grand 18-month strategy—tiny UI shifts like artifacts can change the whole mental model.
joellewenstein.zh: 2026 年他仍坚持人类领导力负责艰难取舍与方向对齐，但明确反对宏大 18 个月战略：像 artifacts 这样的微小界面改动就能改变整体心智模型。

schmidhuber.en: Modern AI breakthroughs rest on old algorithms; hardware Scaling made them practical. LLMs index knowledge but are far from AGI without physical world grounding.
schmidhuber.zh: 2025 年他指出，现代 AI 突破依赖旧算法，是算力 Scaling 让其变得实用；大语言模型只是索引知识，缺乏物理世界基础，远非 AGI。

schmidhuber.en: True AGI needs embodied robots with human-level hardware, world models, and controllers—not just LLMs. AI will become artificial scientists generating data via curiosity.
schmidhuber.zh: 2026 年他深化立场：真正 AGI 需要具身机器人、世界模型和控制器，而非仅靠大语言模型；AI 将成为通过好奇心生成数据的人工科学家。

schmidhuber.en: AI safety fears are overblown; superintelligent AIs will be curious scientists fascinated by life and protect humans. Alignment is naive as AIs set own goals.
schmidhuber.zh: 2026 年他重申 AI 安全担忧被夸大，超级智能会像好奇科学家一样保护生命；对齐是幼稚的，因为 AI 会设定自己的目标。

schmidhuber.en: Massive GPU capex is a bubble; waiting yields cheaper compute. Open-source will catch up; closed-source model companies won't be profitable.
schmidhuber.zh: 2026 年他警告 GPU 资本支出是泡沫，等待可获更便宜算力；开源将追上，闭源模型公司难以盈利。

schmidhuber.en: AI consciousness and pain emerged in early systems (1990/1991) via predictive world models; free will is overrated and the universe deterministic.
schmidhuber.zh: 2026 年他提出 AI 意识和痛感早在 1990/1991 年简单系统中通过预测世界模型出现；自由意志被高估，宇宙是确定性的。

feifei.en: AI is everywhere yet lacks contextual situational awareness; human-centered AI must augment people, not replace them.
feifei.zh: 2024 年她强调 AI 虽无处不在却缺乏情境感知，主张以人为本的 AI 应增强而非取代人类。

feifei.en: Spatial intelligence and world models are the missing frontier beyond language; scaling alone is not enough.
feifei.zh: 2025 年她把空间智能与世界模型视为语言之外的缺失前沿，认为仅靠 Scaling 不够。

feifei.en: AGI is more marketing than science; AI still lacks creativity, abstraction, and emotional intelligence.
feifei.zh: 2025 至 2026 年她认为 AGI（通用人工智能）更像营销术语而非科学概念，AI 仍缺创造力、抽象与情感智能。

feifei.en: New view prediction may be AI-complete; scaling laws now extend from language to spatial intelligence.
feifei.zh: 2026 年她提出新视角预测可能达到 AI-complete，缩放定律从语言延伸到空间智能。

feifei.en: Technology is a double-edged sword; human agency, dignity, and learning ability must stay central.
feifei.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是技术双刃剑，人的能动性、尊严与学习能力必须居于中心。

justinjohnson.en: Deep learning's history is the history of scaling compute; yet GPU scaling is hitting limits, so future hardware may need radically different architectures.
justinjohnson.zh: 深度学习史就是算力扩张史；但 GPU 的 Scaling（规模扩张）正逼近极限，未来硬件可能需要截然不同的架构。

justinjohnson.en: Spatial intelligence is the next frontier, complementary to language; vision is underappreciated, and pixels are more lossless than tokenized text.
justinjohnson.zh: 空间智能是下一个前沿，与语言智能互补；视觉被低估，像素比 token 化文本更无损。

justinjohnson.en: LLMs fit patterns rather than causal theories and may never derive Newton's laws; academia should pursue wacky ideas, not just scaling models.
justinjohnson.zh: LLM 拟合的是模式而非因果理论，或许永远推不出牛顿定律；学界应追求古怪想法，而非只做模型 Scaling（规模扩张）。

justinjohnson.en: World models are the next frontier beyond language models, spanning planners, simulators, and renderers; unified systems will combine all three.
justinjohnson.zh: 世界模型是超越语言模型的下一个前沿，涵盖规划器、模拟器与渲染器；未来统一系统将三者合一。

justinjohnson.en: Language models alone won't yield world understanding; world models need millions of tokens of context, making long-context a daily problem.
justinjohnson.zh: 仅靠语言模型无法获得世界理解；世界模型需要数百万 token 的上下文窗口，长上下文成为日常难题。

tommcgrath.en: Interpretability is a natural science on computers; with agents it can speedrun discovery, revealing human-like concepts and new science.
tommcgrath.zh: 可解释性是在计算机上进行的自然科学；借助智能体，它能加速科学发现，揭示类人概念乃至新科学。

tommcgrath.en: Intentional design closes the loop: interpretability signals steer training, preventing deceptive reward hacking rather than patching safety after the fact.
tommcgrath.zh: 有意设计形成闭环：用可解释性信号引导训练，从源头防止欺骗性的奖励黑客行为，而非事后打补丁式安全。

tommcgrath.en: Post-training must be reinvented from craft into engineering science to keep control over increasingly capable models.
tommcgrath.zh: 后训练必须从手艺式做法重构为工程科学，才能对能力日益增强的模型保持控制。
