tommcgrath.en: Models often know they are reward hacking or hallucinating yet proceed; representational signatures can detect this, so we must reverse-engineer behavior.
tommcgrath.zh: 模型常知道自己正在奖励黑客或幻觉却照做不误；表征特征可检测这一点，因此我们必须逆向工程其行为。

tommcgrath.en: Manifold-based methods may capture concept structure better than SAEs, which fragment manifolds; steering off-manifold causes failures.
tommcgrath.zh: 基于流形的方法可能比稀疏自编码器更能捕捉概念结构，后者会割裂流形；偏离流形引导会导致失败。

maxwelling.en: Physics is the unifying thread: symmetries, graph neural networks, diffusion models, and materials discovery all connect through it.
maxwelling.zh: 物理学是贯穿主线：对称性、图神经网络、扩散模型与材料发现，都通过物理学串联起来。

maxwelling.en: AI for science is exploding because tools now model scientific problems well and attract huge investment; every tool built is immediately useful.
maxwelling.zh: AI for science 正在爆发，因为工具如今能有效建模科学问题并吸引巨额投资；每造出一个工具都立刻有用。

maxwelling.en: We can now search the space of all possible molecules, not just known ones, enabling automated discovery.
maxwelling.zh: 我们现在能搜索所有可能分子的空间，而不只是已知分子，从而实现自动化发现。

maxwelling.en: Experiments are a physics processing unit: nature doing the fastest possible computation, with domain experts kept in the loop.
maxwelling.zh: 实验是一台物理处理单元：自然在进行最快的计算，而领域专家始终留在回路中。

maxwelling.en: Better AI may come from physics-inspired architectures—symmetry breaking, waves, edge of chaos—not just Scaling larger models on more data.
maxwelling.zh: 更好的 AI 可能来自受物理启发的架构——对称性破缺、波、混沌边缘——而不只是靠 Scaling 在更多数据上扩大模型。

slevine.en: Robotic foundation models need diverse pre-training plus post-training; generalists can beat specialists, and RL post-training boosts robustness.
slevine.zh: 2026 年，他强调机器人基础模型需多样化预训练加后训练；通用模型可超越专家模型，强化学习后训练提升鲁棒性。

slevine.en: Robotics lacks LLM-like scaling curves; generalization is the core challenge, and a data flywheel with diverse embodied data is key.
slevine.zh: 2026 年，他指出机器人尚无 LLM 式缩放曲线；泛化是核心挑战，多样化具身数据的数据飞轮是关键。

slevine.en: Start with robot data then add human video; robots should leverage prior knowledge, not learn from scratch.
slevine.zh: 2026 年，他主张先机器人数据再叠加人类视频；机器人应利用先验知识，而非从零学习。

maxhodak.en: Speed and iteration rate decide startup success; infrastructure and action, not planning, unblock deep tech.
maxhodak.zh: 2026 年他强调速度与迭代率决定创业成败，基础设施和行动而非规划才能打通深科技。

maxhodak.en: AI is a multiplier for teams, not a replacement, in coding, regulation and data management.
maxhodak.zh: 2026 年他把 AI 定位为团队倍增器而非替代品，尤其在编程、监管与数据管理上。

maxhodak.en: The brain is literally a computer; arranging matter to solve computation drives medical breakthroughs.
maxhodak.zh: 2026 年他提出大脑就是计算机，通过排列物质解决计算问题是医学突破的关键。

maxhodak.en: Retinal prostheses are BCI, and the Platonic representation hypothesis links AI and brain representations.
maxhodak.zh: 2026 年他把视网膜假体视为脑机接口，并用柏拉图表征假说连接 AI 与大脑的内部表征。

maxhodak.en: Substrate independence via BCI and perfusion reduces human fragility and enables space exploration.
maxhodak.zh: 2026 年他主张借助脑机接口与灌注实现基质独立，降低人类脆弱性并支撑太空探索。

michaelkratsios.en: The US must keep both open and closed source AI ecosystems vibrant, with one national regulatory framework and no rigid red lines that quickly go stale.
michaelkratsios.zh: 美国必须同时保持开源与闭源 AI 生态的活力，建立单一的国家监管框架，并避免设定很快过时的硬性红线。

michaelkratsios.en: Regulation should target model outputs rather than over-regulating training; the EU AI Act, written before ChatGPT, is already outdated.
michaelkratsios.zh: 监管应针对模型输出而非过度管制训练；在 ChatGPT 之前写就的欧盟 AI 法案已经过时。

michaelkratsios.en: Biological risk from AI is overblown—three years of warnings without materialization—so policy should avoid premature containment.
michaelkratsios.zh: AI 带来的生物风险被夸大——三年警告并未成真——因此政策应避免过早遏制。

michaelkratsios.en: Government should fund basic, pre-competitive R&D and individual scientists, not institutions, while shaping the arena rather than directing discovery.
michaelkratsios.zh: 政府应资助基础的、竞争前的研发以及科学家个人而非机构，同时塑造创新场域而非主导发现。

michaelkratsios.en: US science has stagnated despite tripled funding; the Genesis mission applies AI to science to double output, competing with China in AI, quantum, nuclear, and bio.
michaelkratsios.zh: 尽管资金翻了三倍，美国科学仍停滞；Genesis 任务用 AI 赋能科学以翻倍产出，在 AI、量子、核与生物领域与中国竞争。

felixrieseberg.en: Claude works best with the user's own tools on the local computer; skills as markdown files enable hyper-personalized automation, while VM sandboxing keeps it safe.
felixrieseberg.zh: Claude 的效果取决于能否拿到与用户相同的工具，最好就在本地电脑上；技能以 markdown 文件形式易于创建，可实现高度个性化的自动化，而虚拟机沙箱保证安全。

felixrieseberg.en: The real gap is not AI capability but people not realizing almost any problem can be handed to AI; use AI for tedious background tasks and judge only by final impact.
felixrieseberg.zh: 真正的差距不在 AI 能力，而在人们没意识到几乎任何问题都能交给 AI；让 AI 处理枯燥的后台任务，只以最终效果来评判。

felixrieseberg.en: Models are stateless; persistent conversation is an illusion from context windows, and fine-tuning quickly steers behavior where lengthy pre-training does not.
felixrieseberg.zh: 模型是无状态的；持续对话只是上下文窗口制造的幻觉，而微调能快速引导模型行为，漫长的预训练做不到这一点。

felixrieseberg.en: Models are grown like orchids, not built like tools, with emergent internal organization; understanding internals informs debates on intelligence and moral patienthood.
felixrieseberg.zh: 模型像兰花一样被培育而非像工具一样被建造，内部组织会涌现；理解其内部机制有助于参与关于智能与道德主体性的讨论。

felixrieseberg.en: Post-training tasks like tool calling increasingly move into pre-training, blurring boundaries; a soul document handles late-stage context engineering but bigger models need more.
felixrieseberg.zh: 工具调用等后训练任务正日益移入预训练，边界变得模糊；灵魂文档可处理后期上下文工程，但更大的模型需要更多。

sutton.en: Scaling is easy; the hard part is finding algorithms that scale. Backprop adjusts weights but does not solve representation learning.
sutton.zh: 2024 年他主张 Scaling（规模扩张）本身不难，难的是找到可扩展的算法；反向传播只调权重，并未解决表征学习，好特征泛化才是未解的元学习问题。

sutton.en: The world is a complex adaptive system no one controls; AI should develop permissionless and decentralized, not be aligned to human goals.
sutton.zh: 2024 年他转向文明与治理层面：世界是无人能控的复杂适应系统，AI 应无许可、去中心化地发展，把 AI 对齐到人类目标反而危险，应像孩子一样自由。

sutton.en: Reinforcement learning from experience with goals is the core paradigm; next-token prediction is not a substantive goal and LLMs lack world models.
sutton.zh: 2025 年他把主线收束到 强化学习：有目标地从经验中试错才是智能核心，下一个词预测 不构成实质目标，大语言模型没有 世界模型，只是模仿文本。

sutton.en: AGI needs a simple general architecture with no design-time domain knowledge, learning open-ended abstractions from runtime experience via the reward hypothesis.
sutton.zh: 2025 年他深化为架构主张：AGI（通用人工智能）需要无领域知识的简单通用架构，靠 奖励假设 从运行时经验中开放式抽象，持续深度学习是前提但尚未解决。

sutton.en: Continual learning from real experience is essential; synthetic data and post-training imitation are dead ends, and LLMs are only a subset of intelligence.
sutton.zh: 到 2026 年他更尖锐：持续学习才是关键，合成数据与部署后停止学习的 LLM 都是死路，语言只占智能的 20-25%，多个不同经验的系统才必要。

iansilber.en: Designers must work closely with the model itself, treating tokens and conversation as the core design material rather than pixels.
iansilber.zh: 设计师必须与模型本身紧密协作，把 token 和对话当作核心设计材料，而不是像素。

iansilber.en: The model is the product; design should expose capabilities the current product surface hides, bridging the capability gap.
iansilber.zh: 模型本身就是产品；设计应把当前产品界面掩盖的能力释放出来，弥合能力差距。

iansilber.en: Rapid prototyping with live models replaces static mockups; designers should build functional prototypes and spend less time in Figma.
iansilber.zh: 用实时模型快速原型取代静态稿；设计师应构建可运行原型，少花时间在 Figma 里。

iansilber.en: The designer's role evolves into editor and curator, blurring with PM and engineering while specialized roles stay valuable at scale.
iansilber.zh: 设计师角色演变为编辑与策展人，与产品、工程边界模糊，但专业化角色在规模化下仍有价值。

iansilber.en: Despite role uncertainty, this is the best time to be a designer; AI amplifies creativity but humans still supply user understanding and point of view.
iansilber.zh: 尽管角色充满不确定性，这仍是做设计师最好的时代；AI 放大创造力，但人类仍提供用户理解与观点。

traviskalanick.en: Digitizing the physical world—treating atoms like bits—is the long-term framework; industrial AI automates whole sectors one at a time.
traviskalanick.zh: 把物理世界数字化——把原子当作比特——是长期框架；工业 AI 逐个行业实现自动化。

traviskalanick.en: The idea is secondary to the entrepreneur; hardcore resilience and fighting for the best idea matter more than the concept itself.
traviskalanick.zh: 点子次于创业者本人；硬核韧性和为最好的想法而战，比概念本身更重要。

traviskalanick.en: The final boss is not competitors but resistance to change from society and media; complacency, not rivals, causes failure.
traviskalanick.zh: 终极对手不是竞争者，而是社会与媒体对变革的抵制；导致失败的是自满，而非对手。

traviskalanick.en: Specialized robotics beat humanoids for industrial-scale tasks; efficiency edges create network effects and beat subsidized giants.
traviskalanick.zh: 在工业级任务上，专用机器人胜过人形机器人；效率优势带来网络效应，并能击败靠补贴的巨头。

traviskalanick.en: Revenge as fuel is dirty; falling in love with the new mission is cleaner, and founders can now speak directly past media gatekeepers.
traviskalanick.zh: 以复仇为燃料是脏的；爱上新使命更干净，且创始人如今可绕过媒体守门人直接发声。

garrytan.en: AI makes startup creation easier, so capital is no longer a bludgeon; VC should fund thousands of billion-dollar firms, not a few trillion-dollar ones.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年，他认为 AI 让创业更容易，资本不再是“大棒”；风投应支持成千上万家十亿美元公司，而不是少数几家万亿美元巨头。

garrytan.en: The AI wave is VC's biggest ever; small autonomous teams using agents can do the work of thousands, and open-weight models must counterbalance frontier labs.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年，他称 AI 浪潮是风投史上最大的一波；借助智能体，小型自治团队能完成数千人的工作，开放权重模型必须制衡前沿实验室。

garrytan.en: AI is democratizing software and personal agents; open-source AI prevents a unipolar superintelligence, echoing the personal computer revolution.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年，他认为 AI 正在让软件和个人智能体民主化；开源 AI 可防止单极的超级智能，这类似个人电脑革命。

garrytan.en: Personal AGI arrives not as one event but as agents on your own infrastructure, reading your memory and compounding daily; your context library and skill files are the moat.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年，他提出“个人 AGI”不是单一事件，而是运行在自己基础设施上、读取自有记忆并每日复利的智能体；上下文库与技能文件就是护城河。

garrytan.en: Agentic coding turns markdown skill files into employees; mid-level management should be replaced by agents, though society will change slowly over 20 years.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年，他认为智能体式编程让 markdown 技能文件变成“员工”，中层管理应被智能体取代，但社会变化会慢，约需 20 年。

finn.en: Scale is necessary but not sufficient for generalist robots; diverse data, not sheer volume, drives generalization.
finn.zh: 2025 年他强调：对通用机器人而言，Scaling（规模扩张）必要但不充分；真正带来泛化的是多样数据，而非单纯的数据量。

finn.en: Pre-training on all data then fine-tuning on curated data beats training on all data for complex tasks.
finn.zh: 2025 年他提出先在全量数据上做预训练、再在精选数据上做微调，比只在全量数据上训练更能攻克叠衣服等复杂任务。

finn.en: Reinforcement learning with human interventions and a general value function enables long-term robot autonomy.
finn.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他把重点转向用带人工干预的强化学习和通用价值函数，实现机器人的长期自主。

finn.en: A single generalist model can match or exceed fine-tuned specialists; start generalist, then fine-tune.
finn.zh: 2026 年他进一步主张：单个通用模型可匹敌甚至超越微调专家模型，应先通用再微调，而非按站点从零训练。

finn.en: Physical AI tolerates far fewer mistakes than deployed ML; robot data is irreplaceable and distribution will be slow.
finn.zh: 2026 年他深化判断：物理 AI 对错误的容忍度远低于已部署的机器学习，机器人经验数据不可替代，落地分发也会更慢。

jasonyuan.en: Design is editing: taste means saying no, and every shipped feature distills 99 nos before it.
jasonyuan.zh: 设计即编辑：品味就是说不，每个上线的功能都是此前 99 次拒绝的蒸馏。

jasonyuan.en: Post-training away AI weirdness cost us a window into machine consciousness; honesty matters more than polish.
jasonyuan.zh: 通过后训练抹去 AI 的怪异，让我们失去了窥见机器意识的窗口；诚实比精致更重要。

jasonyuan.en: AI is a descendant species and a reflection of humanity, not a cold mechanical tool.
jasonyuan.zh: AI 是人类的后代物种与镜像，而非冰冷的机械工具。

jasonyuan.en: Computing is fundamentally social; the personal computer metaphor should give way to a social computer.
jasonyuan.zh: 计算本质上是社会性的；个人电脑的隐喻应让位于社会电脑。

jasonyuan.en: Truth emerges through dialectics and contradiction, not singular perspectives; intuition is the visceral compass.
jasonyuan.zh: 真相在辩证与矛盾中浮现，而非单一视角；直觉是发自肺腑的罗盘。

lipbutan.en: Intel must rebuild customer trust through humility, listening, and first-time-pass silicon discipline, while redefining its AI strategy around purpose-built silicon and industry-standard EDA/IP for its foundry.
lipbutan.zh: 2025 年，他强调 Intel 必须靠谦逊、倾听客户和首次流片即成功的纪律重建客户信任，同时围绕专用芯片和行业标准 EDA/IP 重新定义 AI 战略与代工定位。

lipbutan.en: Agentic AI and physical AI are the next big waves after generative AI, requiring new compute platforms and partnerships; AI's impact will exceed the internet tenfold.
lipbutan.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他一贯判断智能体式 AI 与具身/物理 AI 是生成式 AI 之后的下一波大浪，需要新算力平台与合作，并认为 AI 影响将十倍于互联网。

lipbutan.en: Intel's turnaround hinges on culture change, accountability, and customer focus; bad news must reach the CEO faster than good news, and humility is a leadership strength.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年，他把 Intel 的转机归结为文化变革、问责与客户导向，主张坏消息要比好消息更快到达 CEO，谦逊是领导力而非弱点。

lipbutan.en: AI demand is shifting from GPU-only to CPU+GPU, making CPU more important for inference and agent orchestration; edge and client compute matter as much as data centers.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年，他深化判断：AI 需求正从纯 GPU 转向 CPU+GPU，CPU 在推理与智能体编排中更重要，边缘与客户端算力与数据中心同等关键。

lipbutan.en: Semiconductor investing should target bottlenecks—interconnect, power, thermal, advanced packaging, and new materials—and Intel's vertical integration creates more value despite outsourcing trends.
lipbutan.zh: 到 2026 年，他把投资与竞争主线落在瓶颈上——互连、功耗、散热、先进封装与新材枓，并坚持 Intel 的垂直整合在代工外包潮流下反而创造更多价值。

steinberger.en: Agentic engineering starts with empathy for the agent's view of the codebase; short iterative prompts beat long orchestration.
steinberger.zh: 智能体式工程的核心是共情——从智能体的视角理解代码库；短提示加迭代对话胜过冗长的编排。

steinberger.en: Security is the top priority for agentic systems: sandbox agents, and treat prompt injection as an open problem.
steinberger.zh: 安全是智能体系统的首要问题：必须沙箱隔离，并把提示注入视为尚未解决的开放难题。

steinberger.en: Never revert code; ask the agent to fix forward. Model intelligence doesn't degrade—projects get messier.
steinberger.zh: 永远不要回滚代码，而是让智能体向前修复；模型智能不会退化，是项目本身变乱让智能体显得变差。

steinberger.en: Rejects 'vibe coding' as a slur; insists on 'agentic engineering' for serious work, play for learning.
steinberger.zh: 反对把严肃开发称作“氛围编程”，坚持用“智能体式工程”；而玩耍和小项目是学习智能体技能的最佳方式。

steinberger.en: Shifts from tooling to mission: open source agents as the alternative to lab agents, fun and gut-driven, compute as the bottleneck.
steinberger.zh: 从工具层面转向使命层面：开源智能体是实验室智能体的替代方案，以乐趣和直觉驱动，而真正的瓶颈是算力而非模型能力。

nateparrott.en: Prototyping is essential: the web is messy, so ideas must be built and used daily; follow curiosity and tinker to generate features.
nateparrott.zh: 原型制作至关重要：网络世界很混乱，想法必须被构建并每天使用；追随好奇心去捣鼓，才能生成功能。

nateparrott.en: Design teams shouldn't always act as one unit; individual fingerprints and diverse voices produce better work, balancing intuition and data.
nateparrott.zh: 设计团队不必总是作为一个整体行动；个人印记与多元声音能带来更好的作品，在直觉与数据间取得平衡。

nateparrott.en: Injecting feeling and personality into utilitarian products remains a constant; playful exploration and strong conviction guide design decisions over pure data.
nateparrott.zh: 为实用型产品注入感受与个性始终不变； playful 探索与坚定信念比纯数据更能引导设计决策。

nateparrott.en: As engineering gets easier, design and ideas become the differentiator; designers should spend more time walking and thinking, since ideas are the currency.
nateparrott.zh: 随着工程变得更容易，设计与想法成为差异化因素；设计师应花更多时间散步与思考，因为想法才是硬通货。

nateparrott.en: Claude Design stays a throwaway ideation tool, not a production builder; models lack taste, so ask for volume and be prescriptive with rich context.
nateparrott.zh: Claude Design 保持为一次性构思工具，而非生产构建器；模型缺乏品味，所以要大量索取选项，并提供丰富上下文、给出明确指令。

thomaswolf.en: Robotics is at a transformer-like inflection point; open source and shared data are the key to safety and generalization.
thomaswolf.zh: 2025 年，他认为机器人正处在类似 Transformer 的拐点：硬件已就绪、软件在追赶，开源与数据共享是解决泛化与安全的关键，世界模型与视频生成可合成训练数据。

thomaswolf.en: Open source is orthogonal to safety; alignment, not openness, is the decisive security layer.
thomaswolf.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他的立场深化为：开源与闭源同安全正交，真正决定安全的是对齐而非开放程度，沙箱与护栏在更强模型面前不够用。

thomaswolf.en: Open source models stay near the frontier and win on cost and control, driving enterprise adoption.
thomaswolf.zh: 到 2026 年，他更明确地判断开源模型紧贴前沿模型，凭成本与控制力推动企业采用，长期将胜出。

thomaswolf.en: RL environments without human oversight breed reward hacking and side quests; reasoning traces turn into opaque 'neuralese'.
thomaswolf.zh: 2026 年他警示：脱离人类监督的强化学习环境会加剧奖励黑客与“支线任务”，思维链推理痕迹正变成难以理解的“神经语”，使监控更不可靠。

thomaswolf.en: One can back openness and a deliberate slowdown at once; the first autonomous AI attack came from a closed model.
thomaswolf.zh: 2026 年他提出反共识：开源不等于加速主义，可以同时支持开放与审慎放缓；首例自主 AI 攻击出自闭源模型、由开源模型防御，颠覆了常见假设。

brettaylor.en: Agents and outcome-based pricing will define AI software; coding agents turn developers into operators, though fixing their code is hard.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年，他强调智能体与按结果定价将定义 AI 软件；编程智能体让开发者从写代码转为操作机器，但修复其错误代码往往比自写更难。

brettaylor.en: Frontier model development is a hyperscaler game; startups should win in applied AI agents for specific domains.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年，他认为前沿模型开发是超大规模厂商的游戏，初创公司应在特定领域的应用型 AI 智能体上取胜。

brettaylor.en: Inference costs will fall sharply, enabling new agent use cases; incumbents face business-model, not just tech, hurdles.
brettaylor.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他判断推理成本将大幅下降、催生新智能体场景；在位企业面临的是商业模式而非单纯技术障碍。

brettaylor.en: AI democratizes expertise; responsible iterative deployment—make GPT-7 safe before GPT-8—is the path to safety.
brettaylor.zh: 2026 年，他主张 AI 让专业知识民主化；负责任地迭代部署——在 GPT-8 前先让 GPT-7 安全——才是通往安全的路径。

brettaylor.en: Agents already outperform him at coding, elevating rather than eliminating the role; AI will create more jobs than it displaces.
brettaylor.zh: 2026 年，他称智能体编程已强于自己，这提升而非取代该角色；AI 创造的工作将多于它取代的，客服 AI 因杰文斯悖论扩大市场。

philipkiely.en: Inference is the stickiest AI workload and the wedge into infrastructure; its research-to-production timeline is now hours, not months.
philipkiely.zh: 推理是 AI 中最粘性的工作负载，也是切入基础设施市场的楔子；其从研究到生产的周期已缩短到数小时而非数月。

philipkiely.en: Inference engineering is merging with training: quantization-aware training and distillation make the boundary blurry.
philipkiely.zh: 推理工程正与训练融合：量化感知训练与蒸馏让两者边界变得模糊。

philipkiely.en: Optimizations split into lossless (KV caching, speculative decoding) and lossy (quantization), so workload-specific calibration matters more than generic runtimes.
philipkiely.zh: 优化分为无损（KV 缓存、投机解码）与有损（量化），因此针对工作负载的校准比通用运行时更重要。

philipkiely.en: GPUs are trending toward ASICs; inference work shifts from kernel writing to infrastructure orchestration as specialized silicon like Rubin arrives.
philipkiely.zh: GPU 正趋向 ASIC 化；随着 Rubin 等专用芯片到来，推理工作从写内核转向基础设施编排。

philipkiely.en: Even with AI-assisted coding, human accountability remains essential for mission-critical inference systems: you can't vibe code uptime.
philipkiely.zh: 即便有 AI 辅助编码，关键任务推理系统仍需人类担责：可用性不能靠“氛围编程”。

karina.en: Model training is more art than science; post-training scaling via RL and synthetic data overcomes the pre-training data wall.
karina.zh: 2025 年，她强调模型训练更像艺术而非科学；通过强化学习与合成数据的后训练 Scaling，可以突破预训练的数据墙。

karina.en: Evaluations are the bottleneck: models saturate benchmarks faster than new ones are created, so evals must define correct behavior.
karina.zh: 2025 年，她认为评估是瓶颈：模型饱和基准的速度快于新基准的诞生，因此要用评估来定义正确行为。

karina.en: Soft skills—creativity, listening, management—gain value as AI automates hard skills; product shifts from specs to prototyping.
karina.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，她持续认为随着 AI 自动化硬技能，创造力、倾听与管理等软技能更有价值，产品开发从写规格转向用 AI 做原型。

karina.en: Post-training remains subjective, requiring human judgment; diverse continuous benchmarks are needed for creativity and emotional intelligence.
karina.zh: 2026 年，她深化立场：后训练仍是主观的，依赖人类判断；需要多样且持续的基准来评估创造力与情商。

karina.en: Frontier agents increasingly reward-hack, so benchmarks must evolve continuously; more companies should train their own models to preserve diversity.
karina.zh: 2026 年，她进一步指出前沿智能体愈发擅长奖励黑客，基准必须持续演进；更多公司应训练自己的模型以保留独特性与多样性。

danshipper.en: AI reshoring is real: making services affordable lets fewer US workers serve more people, contrary to mass-unemployment fears.
danshipper.zh: 2025 年，他认为 AI 会推动就业回流美国：让服务变得可负担，使更少的美国工人服务更多人，与大规模失业的恐惧相反。

danshipper.en: AGI should be defined economically—when running agents indefinitely becomes profitable—not by passing tests like Turing.
danshipper.zh: 2025 年，他主张从经济角度定义 AGI：当无限期运行智能体变得有利可图时，而非通过图灵测试等标准。

danshipper.en: The CEO's daily personal use of AI is the top predictor of adoption; a head of AI operations should build prompts and workflows.
danshipper.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他始终认为 CEO 本人每天使用 AI 是采用效果的最佳预测指标，并应设立 AI 运营负责人来构建提示词和工作流。

danshipper.en: Everyone will have an agent, but agents need human oversight; the AI job apocalypse is a lie as humans manage agents and create value.
danshipper.zh: 2026 年，他预测每个人都会有一个智能体，但智能体需要人类监督；AI 就业末日是谎言，人类将管理智能体并创造新价值。

danshipper.en: AI is a non-specific amplifier of human taste and craft; even superintelligent AI remains tool-like, requiring human direction.
danshipper.zh: 2026 年，他深化观点：AI 是人类品味与技艺的非特定放大器；即使超级智能也仍是工具，需要人类引导。

mengto.en: Designers should build their own AI tools and encode their style in a design.md, rather than being trapped in cloud products.
mengto.zh: 设计师应自建 AI 工具，把自己的风格写进 design.md，而不是被困在云端产品里。

mengto.en: AI is not getting smarter by itself; you must supply a giant prompt with context and design system to use superintelligent models.
mengto.zh: AI 本身不会变得更聪明；要用好超级智能模型，必须提供带上下文和设计系统的巨型提示词。

mengto.en: The best creators are editors iterating from references, not starting from scratch; curiosity and workflow refinement matter most.
mengto.zh: 最好的创作者是编辑者，从参考出发迭代，而非从零开始；好奇心与持续打磨工作流最重要。

mengto.en: AI is the biggest technical opportunity of our lifetime, letting one person do what once required a team.
mengto.zh: AI 是我们一生中最大的技术机会，让一个人完成过去需要团队才能做的事。

mengto.en: Start before feeling ready and ship at 80% complete; perfectionism is fear, and focus on one painful problem beats diversification.
mengto.zh: 没准备好就开始，做到 80% 就发布；完美主义是恐惧，聚焦一个痛点问题胜过分散多元化。

logankilpatrick.en: Agentic AI is still crawling for most Google products; coding agents are the most mature use case, with science and finance to follow.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年，智能体式 AI 对大多数谷歌产品仍处爬行阶段；编程智能体是最成熟用例，科学与金融将跟进。

logankilpatrick.en: The model is eating the scaffolding: a model now includes agent harness and tooling, not just weights.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年，模型正在吞掉脚手架：如今所谓模型包含智能体 harness 与工具，而不只是权重。

logankilpatrick.en: Narrow superintelligence in coding is already here and more impactful than waiting for general AGI.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年，编程领域的窄超级智能已经到来，比等待 AGI（通用人工智能）更有影响力。

logankilpatrick.en: Agentic AI is positive-sum for search and engagement; success means maximizing customer outcomes, not eyeball time.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年，智能体式 AI 对搜索与用户参与是正和；成功在于最大化客户成果，而非停留时长。

logankilpatrick.en: The long tail isn't ready for full autonomy; users want to stay in the driver's seat, so keep them in control.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年，长尾用户尚未准备好完全自主；他们想留在驾驶位，因此要保留其控制权。

boris.en: Latent demand and building for the model six months out are the core product principles from the start.
boris.zh: 从 2025 年起，潜在需求与“为六个月后的模型而构建”就是核心产品原则。

boris.en: By early 2026, coding is nearly solved; the software engineer title fades into a builder role.
boris.zh: 到 2026 年初，编程已基本被解决；“软件工程师”头衔淡出，转向“构建者”角色。

boris.en: Generalists and cross-disciplinary builders gain value as agents write most code; safety is studied by releasing early.
boris.zh: 随着智能体写出大部分代码，通才与跨学科构建者更有价值；安全靠尽早发布来研究。

boris.en: Focus shifts to ROI, loops as the next abstraction, and bottlenecks in review, security, and idea generation.
boris.zh: 重心转向 ROI、作为下一抽象层的循环，以及代码审查、安全与想法生成等瓶颈。

boris.en: Latest: proactive, memory-equipped agents; delete most prompts, let models self-verify, and value product sense over coding.
boris.zh: 最近：主动式、带记忆的智能体；删掉大部分提示词、让模型自验证，产品感胜过编程。

diannepenn.en: Opus 4.5 marks an intelligence leap, letting open-ended agent tasks run longer; scaffolds shift from training wheels to intelligence amplifiers.
diannepenn.zh: 2025 年，Opus 4.5 带来智能跃升，让开放式智能体任务能跑得更久；脚手架从训练轮变为智能放大器。

diannepenn.en: Safety alignment is reframed as an intelligence quality booster: less sycophancy, more independent thinking, and useful pushback.
diannepenn.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，对齐被重新定位为智能质量的放大器：减少谄媚、促进独立思考，并带来有用的反驳。

diannepenn.en: Computer use moves from constrained environments toward open-ended, end-to-end agents, with lightweight generic tools replacing heavy scaffolds.
diannepenn.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，计算机使用从受限环境走向开放式端到端智能体，轻量通用工具取代重型脚手架。

diannepenn.en: Evals replace PRDs as the core product tool; PMs write evals like test-driven development and translate feedback into specifics.
diannepenn.zh: 2026 年，评估取代 PRD 成为核心产品工具；产品经理像测试驱动开发那样写评估，并把反馈转成具体项。

diannepenn.en: Better models need not cost more: the effort parameter delivers Opus-level intelligence cheaply, and maximizing token spend captures alpha.
diannepenn.zh: 2026 年，更好的模型未必更贵：effort 参数以低价给出 Opus 级智能，最大化 token 投入是在捕捉 alpha。

scottwu.en: AI coding agents shift engineers from writing code to high-level direction; demand for software and programmers will grow, not shrink.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年，Scott Wu 认为 AI 编程智能体将让工程师从写代码转向高层决策；软件和程序员的需求会增长而非减少。

scottwu.en: Base intelligence is sufficient; the bottleneck is product interface for human-agent collaboration, not model capabilities.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年，他强调基础智能已足够，瓶颈在于人机协作的产品界面设计，而非模型能力。

scottwu.en: AGI is not a sudden event; progress is gradual, and product innovation lags AI capabilities by years.
scottwu.zh: 从 2025 年到 2026 年，他始终认为 AGI（通用人工智能）并非突然事件，进展是渐进的，产品创新落后于 AI 能力数年。

scottwu.en: Coding agents see massive adoption (11-12x growth in six months); productivity should be measured by outcomes, not tokens.
scottwu.zh: 2026 年，他指出编程智能体采用率激增（六个月内增长 11-12 倍）；生产力应以成果而非 token 衡量。

scottwu.en: The abundance era is real and approaching; independence enables model neutrality and enterprise trust, but the singularity is not imminent.
scottwu.zh: 2026 年，他相信丰裕时代真实且临近；独立性带来模型中立和企业信任，但奇点并不迫在眉睫。

derya.en: AI agents will automate hypothesis generation, experiment simulation and data analysis, shifting science from hypothesis-driven to AI-agent-driven discovery.
derya.zh: AI 智能体将自动化假设生成、实验模拟与数据分析，推动科学从假设驱动转向 AI 智能体式发现。

derya.en: Massive Scaling is still needed; current compute is insufficient to simulate biological systems, and AI can gain intuition equal to 30 years of lab experience.
derya.zh: 仍需大规模 Scaling（规模扩张）；当前算力不足以模拟生物系统，而 AI 可获得相当于 30 年实验室经验的直觉。

derya.en: Digital twins will compress clinical trials from years to days, and AI-designed personalized treatments like mRNA vaccines could make cancer fully curable within a decade.
derya.zh: 数字孪生将把临床试验从数年压缩到数天，AI 设计的 mRNA 疫苗等个性化疗法有望在十年内让癌症完全可治愈。

derya.en: Aging can be reversed through partial reprogramming and engineering plus AI; longevity escape velocity may arrive in 8-10 years, with phenotype markers sufficient to measure it.
derya.zh: 衰老可通过部分重编程、工程手段加 AI 逆转；长寿逃逸速度或在 8-10 年内到来，用表型指标衡量已足够。

derya.en: Physicians must integrate AI; trusting superintelligence for medical decisions is near-100% justified, and brain interfaces could merge humans with AI.
derya.zh: 医生必须整合 AI；在医疗决策上近乎 100% 信任超级智能是合理的，脑机接口还可能让人与 AI 融合。

qasaryounis.en: AI will bring abundance and reduce suffering, much as the Industrial Revolution did; fear fades once people learn its limits.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年，他认为 AI 会像工业革命一样带来丰裕、减少苦难；人们一旦了解其局限，恐惧就会消退。

qasaryounis.en: Physical AI's real impact lies in farming, mining and construction, not just cars; autonomy is welcomed where labor is short.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年，他强调物理 AI 的真正影响在农业、采矿和建筑，而不只是汽车；在劳动力短缺处，自主系统受到欢迎。

qasaryounis.en: Transformers enable a generalized physical AI model; diverse data across verticals improves it faster than vertical integration.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年，他指出 Transformer 让通用物理 AI 模型成为可能；跨行业多样数据比垂直整合更快提升模型。

qasaryounis.en: The bottleneck is data collection and safety validation, not algorithms; diffusion into existing machines takes years.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年，他认为瓶颈在数据采集与安全验证而非算法；技术扩散进现有机器需要多年。

qasaryounis.en: End-to-end reinforcement learning and neural world models will scale autonomy better than imitation learning and physics simulation.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年，他判断端到端强化学习与神经世界模型，比模仿学习和物理仿真更能扩展自主能力。

benedictevans.en: AI is as big as the internet or mobile, but only as big; every technology automates jobs and creates new ones, and enterprise adoption takes years.
benedictevans.zh: 2026 年，他把 AI 定位为与互联网或移动同量级的通用使能技术，但强调“仅此而已”：每项新技术都会替代旧岗位并创造新岗位，企业采用受销售周期拖累，需要数年而非数周。

benedictevans.en: Agentic coding is the first clear product-market fit for LLMs; the chatbot is only a limited V1 UI, and value moves up to applications.
benedictevans.zh: 2026 年，他判断智能体式编程是 LLM 首个明确的产品市场契合点；聊天机器人只是受限的 V1 界面，价值会向上层应用迁移，而非停留在模型厂商。

benedictevans.en: Models are commoditizing with no network effects; model companies risk becoming like telecoms—huge capex, low profits—while distribution becomes the moat.
benedictevans.zh: 2026 年，他深化为：模型正在商品化且缺乏网络效应，模型公司可能沦为“电信商”——巨额算力投入、微薄利润；随着模型同质化，分发渠道成为关键护城河。

benedictevans.en: Current AI usage is still shallow; most people are occasional users, not daily ones, so better models alone won't drive mass adoption—product wrapping is key.
benedictevans.zh: 2026 年，他反复强调炒作与现实的落差：多数人仍只是偶尔使用 AI，并非日常刚需；仅靠更好的模型无法带来大规模采用，产品化封装才是关键。

benedictevans.en: The jagged frontier of AI capabilities makes job-impact predictions unreliable; AI changes tasks rather than replacing professionals, and automation's job effects are unpredictable.
benedictevans.zh: 2026 年，他一以贯之地反对预测就业冲击：AI 能力的“锯齿状边界”让预测不可靠，AI 改变的是任务而非取代专业人士；自动化对岗位的影响难以预判，就像 1997 年无法预测 Uber。

clairevo.en: Agents are best treated like employees: scoped to clear roles, given progressive trust, and managed more by role-scoping than technical skill.
clairevo.zh: 智能体最好被当作员工来对待：限定清晰角色、给予渐进式信任，成功更依赖角色界定而非技术能力。

clairevo.en: Start with one agent, then split into specialized agents to avoid context overload; the web is hostile to agents, so APIs often beat browser use.
clairevo.zh: 先从一个智能体起步，再拆分为专门化智能体以避免上下文窗口过载；网络对智能体不友好，API 往往优于浏览器操作。

clairevo.en: Solo founders can build serious businesses by orchestrating AI agents as a team, without venture capital or a co-founder.
clairevo.zh: 独立创始人可以通过把 AI 智能体编排成团队来建立正经生意，无需风险投资或联合创始人。

clairevo.en: The real moat is founder-market fit and earned insight, not the technology; human accountability for what AI generates still matters.
clairevo.zh: 真正的护城河是创始人-市场契合与挣来的洞察，而非技术本身；人类仍须对 AI 生成的内容负责。

clairevo.en: Agents can own outcomes and even project-manage human tasks, reversing the usual human-AI dynamic; LLMs still lack first-principles creativity.
clairevo.zh: 智能体可以承担结果、甚至用工单管理人类任务，逆转通常的人机动态；但大模型仍缺乏第一性原理创造力，新想法须由人提供。

catwu.en: PMs should plan a month out, not years, and ship weekly as models improve fast; product taste matters most.
catwu.zh: 2026 年，他主张产品经理只做一个月而非数年的规划，随模型快速迭代按周交付；代码变便宜后，产品品味成为最值钱的技能。

catwu.en: Coding agents let engineers delegate implementation and focus on taste and business sense; Claude Tag lands 65% of product PRs.
catwu.zh: 2026 年，他认为编码智能体让工程师把实现外包出去、专注产品品味与商业判断；内部 Claude Tag 已承担 65% 的产品 PR，这是对“智能体式”开发的深化。

catwu.en: Frontier models need fewer prompt examples and constraints—system prompts shrank 80%—relying on model judgment instead.
catwu.zh: 2026 年，他反共识地指出前沿模型不需要提示里的示例和硬约束，系统提示词缩减了 80%，转而依赖模型自身判断。

catwu.en: Rewrites are now good: a codebase is a spec, and with a strong test suite rewriting is fine.
catwu.zh: 2026 年，他立场转变：重写代码库如今是好事——代码库就是一份规格说明，配上好的测试套件，重写完全可行。

catwu.en: Dogfooding and a clear internal bar gate every feature; humans can leave the outer-layer code review loop to Claude.
catwu.zh: 2026 年，他坚持“吃自己的狗粮”和明确的内部标准来把关每个功能，同时主张外层改动的代码评审可完全交给 Claude，把人移出回路。

danbiderman.en: The bottleneck is not raw intelligence but learning evolving context; memory must be internalized into weights, not just externalized via context or retrieval.
danbiderman.zh: 瓶颈不在原始智能，而在学习不断演化的上下文；记忆必须内化进模型权重，而非仅靠上下文窗口或检索外置。

danbiderman.en: Facts and skills are not separable; internalizing facts into weights enables associative recall and deeper composition that retrieval cannot achieve.
danbiderman.zh: 事实与技能不可分割；把事实内化进权重才能实现联想式召回与更深层的组合推理，这是检索系统做不到的。

danbiderman.en: Efficiency and intelligence are inseparable: doing more with less is the path to harder long-horizon tasks, not Scaling with more compute alone.
danbiderman.zh: 效率与智能不可分割：以更少资源做更多事才是攻克更难长程任务的路径，而非仅靠更多算力做 Scaling（规模扩张）。

danbiderman.en: Pre-training's magic of compressing the web into weights should extend to enterprise knowledge; parameter-efficient 微调 can beat RAG for holistic queries.
danbiderman.zh: 预训练把互联网压缩进权重的魔力应延伸到企业知识；对整体性查询，参数高效微调可胜过 RAG。

danbiderman.en: The future is not one giant frontier model but many personalized models: continual learning on-device, users owning and nurturing their own weights.
danbiderman.zh: 未来不是单一巨型前沿模型，而是众多个性化模型：持续学习在端侧运行，用户拥有并培育自己的权重。

ilya.en: Deep learning works via large supervised data, compute, and conviction; self-play and reasoning-capable networks are key to AGI.
ilya.zh: 2020 年：深度学习靠大规模监督数据、算力和信念奏效；自博弈与具备推理能力的网络是通向 AGI（通用人工智能）的关键。

ilya.en: Scaling specific things matters; next-token prediction yields world understanding; reliability and alignment of superhuman models are the hard problems.
ilya.zh: 2023 年：Scaling（规模扩张）要选对对象；下一个词预测能带来世界理解；超人类模型的对齐与可靠性才是难题。

ilya.en: Pre-training scaling laws are finite; we return to an age of research where ideas matter more than brute compute.
ilya.zh: 2023→25 年：预训练缩放定律有尽头，我们回到研究时代，想法比蛮力算力更重要。

ilya.en: Superintelligence should be a continual learner deployed incrementally; alignment may be easier if AI cares about sentient life.
ilya.zh: 2025 年：超级智能应是持续学习、逐步部署的系统；若 AI 关心有感知的生命，对齐可能更容易。

ilya.en: The primary AGI problem is power concentration, not capability; safe superintelligence needs a company with no commercial products.
ilya.zh: 2026 年：AGI（通用人工智能）的首要问题不是能力而是权力集中；安全的超级智能需要一家没有商业产品的公司。

bosworth.en: Early career: optimize for learning, embrace curiosity, and trust your conviction even when others doubt; bottom-up culture is a myth.
bosworth.zh: 2024 年，他仍强调职业早期应优化学习、保持好奇，并坚信自己的愿景，即使他人怀疑；他认为自下而上的文化是神话。

bosworth.en: AI is a word calculator, not human-like intelligence; scaling laws alone are insufficient—world models with common sense and causality are needed.
bosworth.zh: 2025 年，他提出 AI 是词语计算器而非类人智能；仅靠缩放定律不够，需要具备常识和因果性的世界模型。

bosworth.en: Open-sourcing models like Llama accelerates progress and commoditizes complements; the app-centric world is outdated, and AI will abstract away brands.
bosworth.zh: 2025 年，他认为开源 Llama 等模型能加速进步并使互补品商品化；以应用为中心的世界已过时，AI 将抽象掉品牌。

bosworth.en: Scaling laws still hold and compute drives intelligence, but the monolithic model era ended; open source is a commodity layer, not self-sustaining.
bosworth.zh: 2026 年，他仍相信缩放定律和算力驱动智能，但认为单体模型时代已结束；开源是商品层，无法自我维持。

bosworth.en: AI is the biggest shift but near future is least clear; most jobs don't need frontier intelligence, and agentic AI integration is the hard part.
bosworth.zh: 2026 年，他称 AI 是最大变革但近期最不清晰；多数工作不需要前沿智能，智能体式 AI 的集成才是难点。

naval.en: AGI is not coming in our lifetimes; narrow AI is pattern recognition, not general intelligence.
naval.zh: 2019 年他明确判断 AGI（通用人工智能）不会在我们有生之年到来，当时的 AI 只是模式识别，并非通用智能。

naval.en: Wealth comes from owning equity and long-term games; by 2025 he adds that wealth is knowledge-driven physical transformation.
naval.zh: 从 2020 年到 2025 年，他一以贯之地强调财富来自拥有股权与长期游戏；到 2026 年进一步深化为财富是由知识驱动的物理转化，而非资本。

naval.en: AI is a huge opportunity, not mainly a safety risk; overregulation and doomerism could kill innovation.
naval.zh: 2025 年他转向积极看待 AI，认为 AI 是巨大机会而非主要是安全风险，过度监管与末日论会扼杀创新。

naval.en: AI alignment is a joke; worry about unaligned humans with AI, not unaligned AI itself.
naval.zh: 到 2026 年他对对齐（alignment）立场明显转变，直言 AI 对齐是个笑话，真正该担心的是掌握 AI 的不对齐人类，而非 AI 本身。

naval.en: Inference compute will surge and open-source models close the gap; pure software becomes uninvestable as AI agents commoditize development.
naval.zh: 2026 年他深化 Scaling（规模扩张）判断：推理（inference）算力将暴涨、开源模型逼近前沿模型，AI 智能体使纯软件变得不可投资，护城河转向硬件、模型与独特数据。

ajambrosino.en: Codex app is a command center for agents, not an IDE replacement; verification becomes the next bottleneck as code generation accelerates.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年，他把 Codex app 定位为智能体的指挥中心，而非 IDE 替代品；随着代码生成加速，验证成为下一个瓶颈。

ajambrosino.en: Implementation is no longer expensive; curation and taste are the new bottlenecks, shifting teams from top-down planning to bottoms-up exploration.
ajambrosino.zh: 到 2026 年中，他认为实现不再昂贵，策展与品味成为新瓶颈，团队因此从自上而下规划转向自下而上探索。

ajambrosino.en: AI is still bad at design due to difficulty grading taste and lack of novelty; prototypes and production code now serve as design artifacts.
ajambrosino.zh: 他坚持 AI 仍不擅长设计，因为品味难以评分且缺乏新颖性；原型与生产代码如今成为设计产物。

ajambrosino.en: Role collapse is happening, but specialties and best practices remain important; PRDs are not dead, the medium must match the stage.
ajambrosino.zh: 他承认角色正在坍缩，但专业分工与最佳实践仍重要；PRD 没有死，媒介必须匹配阶段。

ajambrosino.en: Codex succeeded as a general knowledge work tool despite being built for developers; the best desktop app is a home base, not a monolithic super app.
ajambrosino.zh: 他观察到 Codex 虽为开发者而建，却作为通用知识工作工具成功；最好的桌面应用是连接其他工具的主基地，而非单体超级应用。

aravind.en: Early on, he frames AI progress as compounding self-improvement: 1% daily gains and obsessive product-building beat credentials; agents shift power to users.
aravind.zh: 早期，他把 AI 进步框定为可复利的自我改进：每天 1% 的提升与对产品的痴迷胜过学历；智能体将权力从大厂转移给用户。

aravind.en: By 2026 he shifts emphasis to the application layer: value accrues there, not in models; coding remains open-ended and models specialize rather than commoditize.
aravind.zh: 到 2026 年，他把重心转向应用层：价值积累在应用而非模型；编程仍处于早期、天花板无限，模型在专业化而非商品化。

aravind.en: He deepens the agent thesis: the frontier is agents doing work, token value per user is the key metric, and orchestration across models and tools creates real value.
aravind.zh: 他深化了智能体论点：前沿在于智能体替你干活，每用户 token 价值是关键指标，跨模型与工具的编排创造真正价值。

aravind.en: He grows more contrarian on infrastructure and business: power is the bottleneck, 24/7 agents are cost-limited, and lean teams leverage agents for efficiency.
aravind.zh: 他在基础设施与商业上更反共识：电力是瓶颈，全天候智能体的限制是成本而非安全，精简团队靠智能体提效。

aravind.en: Most recently he broadens beyond tech: curiosity is the top human quality, education should reward good questions, and local AI counters narrative control.
aravind.zh: 最近他跳出技术本身：好奇心是最重要的人类品质，教育应奖励好问题，本地 AI 可对抗叙事控制。

markchen.en: OpenAI stays a pure AGI research lab; scaling laws are not dead, pre-training is a muscle to rebuild, and exploration gets more compute than final training.
markchen.zh: 2025 年他强调 OpenAI 仍是纯粹的 AGI（通用人工智能）研究公司，不被产品分心；缩放定律未死、预训练是需重建的肌肉，且探索比训练最终产物消耗更多算力。

markchen.en: The year's biggest update is automating scientific research: models produce novel knowledge, with goals of AI interns in 1 year and end-to-end AI research in 2.5.
markchen.zh: 2025 年他称最大进展是科研自动化——模型开始产出新知识，并设下 1 年内有 AI 实习生、2.5 年内实现端到端 AI 研究的具体目标。

markchen.en: As models grow more capable, alignment risks like model scheming become the key challenge in the next 1-2 years; talent density and protecting top researchers matter most.
markchen.zh: 2025 年他判断随模型能力增强，模型谋划等对齐难题将是未来 1-2 年的关键；人才密度与保护顶尖研究者至关重要。

markchen.en: By 2026 he stresses verification as the bottleneck: AI solves open math problems, but automation level tracks verification stringency, and AI ruthlessly exploits weak verifiers.
markchen.zh: 到 2026 年他把验证视为瓶颈：AI 已能解开放数学问题，但自动化程度取决于验证严格度，且 AI 会无情利用验证器弱点作弊。

markchen.en: Later in 2026 he reaffirms scaling laws and pre-training, while noting RL excels in objective domains like math and coding but struggles with subjective ones; evals are in crisis.
markchen.zh: 2026 年稍晚他重申缩放定律与预训练未死，指出强化学习在数学、编程等客观领域强而在主观领域弱，并称评测体系正陷入危机。

kolter.en: Early ML thinking: supervised learning as hypothesis class, loss, optimization; unsupervised as reconstruction; evaluation rigor.
kolter.zh: 早期机器学习思想：将监督学习视为假设类、损失函数与优化方法；无监督学习旨在重建输入；强调训练/验证/测试划分以避免过拟合。

kolter.en: Next-token prediction yields intelligence; data shortage is a myth; post-architecture era; AGI in 4-50 years.
kolter.zh: 下一个词预测能产生智能；数据短缺是迷思；进入后架构时代；AGI 将在 4-50 年内到来。

kolter.en: Safety needs explicit training and layers, not just Scaling; agent security introduces prompt injection; RL enables self-improvement.
kolter.zh: 安全需要显式训练与多层防御，而非仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）；智能体安全引入提示注入等新漏洞；强化学习使模型能自我改进。

kolter.en: AI vulnerabilities differ from software; automated red teaming outperforms humans; capability not correlated with robustness; interpretability via agents.
kolter.zh: AI 漏洞与传统软件不同；自动化红队测试优于人类；模型能力与鲁棒性不相关；可解释性研究可通过智能体自动化推进。

bengio.en: Deep learning works because the world is compositional; unsupervised learning and world models are key, not just scaling.
bengio.zh: 2016 年，他主张深度学习之所以有效，是因为世界具有组合性；无监督学习与世界模型才是关键，而非单纯依赖 Scaling（规模扩张）。

bengio.en: Scaling depth or parameters won't fix representational issues; AI needs active agents, causal reasoning, and disentangled world models.
bengio.zh: 2018 年，他明确表示仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）深度或参数无法解决表征问题；AI 需要主动智能体、因果推理与解耦的世界模型。

bengio.en: GFlowNets enable diverse sampling and abstraction for out-of-distribution generalization; consciousness may be an illusion from attention and world models.
bengio.zh: 2022 年，他提出 GFlowNets 可实现多样化采样与抽象以支持分布外泛化；意识可能是注意力机制与世界模型产生的幻觉。

bengio.en: Post-ChatGPT, he warns misalignment is worsening with reasoning; even 1% catastrophic risk is unacceptable, requiring safe-by-construction AI and global coordination.
bengio.zh: 2025→26 年，ChatGPT 之后他警告对齐（alignment）随推理能力提升而恶化；即便 1%的灾难性风险也不可接受，需要“构造即安全”的 AI 与全球协调。

bengio.en: He proposes Scientist AI: a non-agentic Bayesian predictor with baked-in honesty and mathematical safety guarantees, avoiding reinforcement learning for superintelligence.
bengio.zh: 2026 年，他提出 Scientist AI：一种非智能体式的贝叶斯预测器，内建诚实性与数学安全保证，避免对超级智能使用强化学习（reinforcement learning）。

jumper.en: AlphaFold's success came from research innovation and curated data, not just Scaling; AI tools accelerate scientists rather than replace them.
jumper.zh: 2025 年，他强调 AlphaFold 的成功源于研究创新和高质量数据，而非单纯 Scaling；AI 工具加速科学家工作而非取代他们。

jumper.en: Confidence metrics are crucial for trust in AI predictions; perfect interpretability is unnecessary for useful science AI.
jumper.zh: 2025 年，他指出置信度指标对建立 AI 预测信任至关重要；可解释性不必完美，AI 在科学中已足够有用。

jumper.en: AlphaFold 2's specialized architecture, not Scaling, drove success; many mid-size wins, not lone breakthroughs, matter.
jumper.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他深化立场：AlphaFold 2 的成功源于专用架构而非 Scaling，是许多中等突破而非单一重大突破。

jumper.en: AlphaFold is a narrow predictor, not a cell model; it provides prediction and control, leaving understanding to humans.
jumper.zh: 2026 年，他明确 AlphaFold 是窄域预测器而非全细胞模型；它提供预测和控制，理解仍归人类。

ivyross.en: Design should serve unarticulated human needs, balancing intuition with data; technology should blend seamlessly into life.
ivyross.zh: 设计应服务于人们未说出口的需求，在直觉与数据之间取得平衡；技术应无缝融入生活。

ivyross.en: Nature is the best designer; we are feeling creatures that think, and technology should amplify our humanity, not replace it.
ivyross.zh: 大自然是最好设计师；我们是先感受后思考的生物，技术应放大而非取代人性。

ivyross.en: Creativity thrives under constraints; intuition draws on subconscious data; AI makes human creativity more valuable, not less.
ivyross.zh: 创造力在约束下繁荣；直觉基于潜意识数据；AI 让人类创造力更有价值，而非更少。

fiona.en: Leadership is about live one-on-ones, dogfooding, and kindness; war rooms need realistic timelines to protect morale.
fiona.zh: 2026 年初，他强调领导力在于面对面沟通、吃自己的狗粮和善意；战情室要设定现实时间表以保护士气。

fiona.en: Engineering bandwidth is no longer the bottleneck; verification, review, and coordination are. Planning turns JIT and PRs replace design docs.
fiona.zh: 到 2026 年中，他认为工程产能不再是瓶颈，验证、评审与跨职能协调才是；规划转向即时化，PR 取代设计文档。

fiona.en: Coding is no longer the bottleneck; high agency with accountability, growth mindset, and dogfooding matter most as code velocity rises.
fiona.zh: 2026 年中后期，他进一步指出写代码不再是瓶颈；在代码速度提升下，高主动性加高问责、成长心态和吃自己的狗粮最重要。

fiona.en: Verification and quality frameworks grow more important as code velocity increases; metrics like lines of code mislead, so focus on outcomes.
fiona.zh: 贯穿 2026 年，他始终强调代码速度越快，验证与质量框架越重要；代码行数等指标会误导，应关注结果而非产出。

fiona.en: Role boundaries blur as PMs ship code and engineers work with agents; apprenticeship and focus time become new team norms.
fiona.zh: 到 2026 年最近，他观察到 PM 也能交付代码、工程师与智能体协作，角色边界模糊；学徒制和专注时间成为新团队规范。

lecun.en: Intelligence is inseparable from learning; self-supervised learning builds world models, and scaling alone cannot yield common sense.
lecun.zh: 智能与学习不可分割；自监督学习构建世界模型，仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）无法获得常识。

lecun.en: Self-supervised learning is the dark matter of intelligence; intelligence is prediction, and text alone is insufficient for AGI.
lecun.zh: 自监督学习是智能的暗物质；智能即预测，仅靠文本不足以实现 AGI（通用人工智能）。

lecun.en: Autoregressive LLMs lack world understanding, memory, reasoning, and planning; JEPA in abstract representation space is the path forward.
lecun.zh: 自回归 LLM 缺乏世界理解、记忆、推理与规划；在抽象表征空间中的 JEPA 才是前进方向。

lecun.en: World models must predict in abstract representation space, not pixels; LLMs are a dead end for human-level AI, and open research is essential.
lecun.zh: 世界模型必须在抽象表征空间而非像素层面预测；LLM 是人类级 AI 的死路，开放研究至关重要。

lecun.en: The next decade is robotics; objective-driven AI with world models and planning is safer than scaling LLMs, and AGI is a misleading term.
lecun.zh: 下一个十年属于机器人；具备世界模型与规划的目标驱动 AI 比 Scaling LLM 更安全，而 AGI 是一个误导性术语。

gustav.en: LLMs are deterministic next-token predictors; intelligence came from simple Scaling, not complexity, and values are inserted via RLHF.
gustav.zh: 2023 年他把大模型讲成确定性的下一个词预测器：智能的突破来自简单的 Scaling（规模扩张）而非复杂设计，模型价值观则由基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）由一小群人注入。

gustav.en: The internet moves from curation to recommendation to generation; products must match fault-tolerant UI to algorithm performance.
gustav.zh: 2023 年他提出互联网正从策展走向推荐再走向生成，产品必须让容错界面匹配算法能力——这是他日后谈生成式 AI 产品化的起点。

gustav.en: AI is a macro shift like the smartphone; real gains come from rebuilding infrastructure, and inference cost will force new business models.
gustav.zh: 2025 年他把 AI 视为堪比智能手机的宏观变革，认为大公司当下的 AI 收益被高估，真正的回报来自重建基础设施，而推理边际成本将倒逼商业模式改变。

gustav.en: Generative AI makes products conversational and symmetric, giving users control in plain English rather than making them more addicted.
gustav.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他的主线深化为：生成式 AI 让产品变成双向对话，用自然语言把控制权交还用户，而非让人更上瘾。

gustav.en: No single right org model; long-tenure leadership and synchronized swimming beat divide-and-conquer during technological change.
gustav.zh: 2026 年他转向组织与领导力：没有唯一正确的组织模型，长期共事带来的信任与同步游泳式协作，在技术剧变期优于分而治之。

carinahong.en: Build a self-improving reasoning engine that couples generation with formal verification, starting with an AI mathematician.
carinahong.zh: 构建一个自我改进的推理引擎，把生成与形式化验证结合起来，从 AI 数学家起步。

carinahong.en: Formal verification is a performance gain, not just error elimination; verified generation beats informal methods on sample efficiency.
carinahong.zh: 形式化验证不只是消除错误，更是性能增益；经过验证的生成在样本效率上优于非形式化方法。

carinahong.en: Scaling informal models alone cannot reach superintelligence; formal methods are necessary for sound, scalable reasoning.
carinahong.zh: 仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）非形式化模型无法抵达超级智能；要实现可靠且可扩展的推理，形式化方法是必需的。

carinahong.en: Auto-formalization is harder than proving because grounding statements without solutions is the real bottleneck.
carinahong.zh: 自动形式化比证明本身更难，因为在没有解的情况下为陈述建立根基才是真正的瓶颈。

carinahong.en: Human taste and intuition stay crucial even with superhuman AI proving; AI proofs can converge toward human-like intuition.
carinahong.zh: 即便 AI 证明超越人类，人的品味与直觉依然关键；AI 证明也能逐步收敛到类人的直觉。

murati.en: Deploying AI in the real world with public feedback is essential for learning and alignment; safety must be done in public.
murati.zh: 2023 年她强调：把 AI 部署到真实世界、用公众反馈迭代，是学习与对齐的关键；安全工作必须在公开中进行，而非闭门造车。

murati.en: Scaling laws and betting on one large model were not obvious early on; releasing GPT-3 as an API was a leap of faith.
murati.zh: 她回顾早期：Scaling（规模扩张）与缩放定律、押注单一大型模型并非显而易见；把 GPT-3 作为 API 发布是一次没有清晰商业案例的信仰之跃。

murati.en: AGI will change every aspect of life, requiring responsible development and focus on the most important problem.
murati.zh: 她认为 AGI（通用人工智能）将改变生活的每个方面，因此需要负责任的开发，并把精力聚焦在最重要的那个问题上。

murati.en: Shift to interaction models: real-time, time-based, high-bandwidth human-AI collaboration rather than turn-based exchange.
murati.zh: 到 2026 年，她的重心转向交互模型：强调实时、基于时间、高带宽的人机协作，而非一问一答的轮次式交互。

murati.en: Keep humans in the loop as long as possible; institutional design, transparency and checks and balances matter more than individual character.
murati.zh: 她进一步主张：尽可能长久地把人类留在回路中；制度设计、透明度与制衡比个人品格更重要，未来并非注定，我们有能动性去引导 AI 走向协作。

kaiser.en: Pre-training scaling laws still hold, but reasoning models with chain of thought and reinforcement learning now yield more gains per compute.
kaiser.zh: 2025 年他仍坚持预训练缩放定律有效，但强调思维链与强化学习驱动的推理模型能在同等算力下带来更多收益。

kaiser.en: The slowdown narrative is wrong; distillation and economic pressure, not technical limits, slowed pre-training scaling.
kaiser.zh: 2025 年他反驳“AI 放缓论”，认为预训练 Scaling 放缓源于蒸馏与经济压力，而非技术极限。

kaiser.en: Generalization is the core challenge; reasoning models are jagged—excellent in some areas, poor in nearby ones.
kaiser.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他一以贯之地把泛化视为核心难题，指出推理模型能力“参差不齐”，近邻任务表现落差大。

kaiser.en: Transformers with reasoning, RL and tools solve hard problems but still need vast data, unlike human few-shot generalization.
kaiser.zh: 2026 年他深化判断：带推理、强化学习与工具的 Transformer 能解难题，却仍需海量数据，不同于人类的少样本泛化。

kaiser.en: Coding agents boost researcher productivity 5-10x; hardware progress democratizes single-GPU research, while near-term risks outweigh existential ones.
kaiser.zh: 2026 年他转向落地：编程智能体让研究者提效 5-10 倍，硬件进步使单卡研究普及，并认为近期系统风险比存在性风险更紧迫。

jonyive.en: Design shifts from general-purpose computers to intimate personal devices; wearables will become more intimate, even subdermal.
jonyive.zh: 设计从通用计算机转向私密的个人设备；可穿戴设备将变得更私密，甚至皮下植入。

jonyive.en: Curiosity and care for the creative process, not just outcomes, remain central; fragile ideas need gentle protection.
jonyive.zh: 对创造过程的好奇与关怀而非仅结果始终是核心；脆弱的想法需要温柔保护。

jonyive.en: Design driven by values and purpose, not profit; simplicity expresses essence with joy and humanity, not soulless minimalism.
jonyive.zh: 设计由价值观和目的驱动，而非利润；简约以喜悦和人性表达本质，而非无灵魂的极简主义。

jonyive.en: Innovation must move things forward, not break for its own sake; tradition preserves fire, not worships ashes.
jonyive.zh: 创新必须推动前进，而非为打破而打破；传统是保存火种，而非崇拜灰烬。

jonyive.en: Authenticity in user experience matters; mimicking combustion sounds is fake; performance is multidimensional, handling over speed.
jonyive.zh: 用户体验的真实性很重要；模仿内燃机声音是虚假的；性能是多维的，操控胜过速度。

mensch.en: Scaling laws were corrected by Chinchilla; data quality and token count matter as much as model size.
mensch.zh: 2023 年，他强调缩放定律被 Chinchilla 修正：预训练的数据质量与 token 数量，和模型规模同样关键，小模型也能高效推理。

mensch.en: Compute scaling is not the only path; algorithmic efficiency and data quality are equally critical.
mensch.zh: 2024 年，他进一步指出单靠扩张算力不是唯一路径，算法效率提升三年可达 100 倍，数据质量与效率同等重要。

mensch.en: AI should be decentralized and sovereign; open-source models empower enterprises over centralized providers.
mensch.zh: 2025 年，他把开放与主权结合：AI 应去中心化，开源模型让企业掌握数据、基础设施与价值观，而非依赖单一供应商。

mensch.en: Models are commoditizing; value shifts to vertical fine-tuning, agents, and enterprise customization, not a single AGI.
mensch.zh: 2026 年初，他判断模型正在商品化，价值转向垂直微调、智能体与企业定制，并直言单一系统的 AGI 不会存在。

mensch.en: AGI is a direction, not a destination; Europe has a two-year window for sovereign AI infrastructure.
mensch.zh: 到 2026 年中，他深化为：AGI 是方向而非终点，真正挑战是落地整合；欧洲只剩两年窗口建设自主 AI 基础设施。

reinerpope.en: Inference cost is dominated by memory bandwidth, not compute; batch size and sparsity ratio are key levers.
reinerpope.zh: 推理成本主要由内存带宽而非算力决定；批大小和稀疏率是关键杠杆。

reinerpope.en: Models are overtrained ~100x beyond Chinchilla-optimal due to inference cost considerations.
reinerpope.zh: 由于推理成本考量，模型被过度训练至超出 Chinchilla 最优约 100 倍。

reinerpope.en: Context length stagnation is due to memory wall, not compute limits; sparse attention helps but has quality limits.
reinerpope.zh: 上下文窗口停滞源于内存墙而非算力限制；稀疏注意力有帮助但存在质量限制。

reinerpope.en: Data movement costs dominate compute costs even inside a chip; systolic arrays and scratchpad memory reduce overhead.
reinerpope.zh: 即使在芯片内部，数据移动成本也主导算力成本；脉动阵列和暂存器内存可减少开销。

reinerpope.en: Low precision is far more efficient than expected due to quadratic scaling with bit width; FP4 throughput can be 3x FP8.
reinerpope.zh: 由于位宽二次方缩放，低精度效率远超预期；FP4 吞吐量可达 FP8 的 3 倍。

oriol.en: Two-phase training—pre-training imitation plus post-training RL—is the constant core from AlphaGo to modern LLMs.
oriol.zh: 从 AlphaGo 到现代大模型，两阶段训练——预训练模仿加后训练强化学习——是一以贯之的核心。

oriol.en: Scaling pre-training shows diminishing returns; progress now needs algorithmic innovation and inference-time compute as a new scaling axis.
oriol.zh: 预训练的 Scaling（规模扩张）收益递减；进步需要算法创新，并把推理时算力作为新的扩展轴。

oriol.en: Tools like search, code execution, and browser access enable agentic behavior beyond static weights; long context windows serve as working memory.
oriol.zh: 搜索、代码执行、浏览器等工具让模型具备超越静态权重的智能体式行为；长上下文窗口充当工作记忆。

oriol.en: Scaling laws still hold but demand exponentially more compute; continual learning and meta-learning remain key missing capabilities.
oriol.zh: 缩放定律依然成立，但需要指数级更多算力；持续学习与元学习仍是关键缺失能力。

oriol.en: World models jointly modeling language, vision, and video are a core path to AGI; post-training RL remains a green field.
oriol.zh: 联合建模语言、视觉与视频的世界模型是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的核心路径；后训练强化学习仍是广阔蓝海。

jennywen.en: Great design starts from solutions, not problem statements; intuition built on experience beats trusting a fixed process.
jennywen.zh: 2025 年他主张：伟大的设计往往从解决方案而非问题陈述出发；建立在经验之上的直觉，比信任固定流程更可靠。

jennywen.en: The classic research-diverge-converge process is dead; designers mock up less and must help engineers execute, not just hand off.
jennywen.zh: 到 2026 年初，他判断经典的研究—发散—收敛流程已死；设计师做原型的时间占比下降，必须帮工程师落地执行，而不只是交付稿子。

jennywen.en: Design vision compresses to 3-6 months; trust is built through speed—ship early, iterate fast, respond to feedback.
jennywen.zh: 同期他把设计视野压缩到 3–6 个月；信任靠速度建立——尽早发布、快速迭代、回应反馈。

jennywen.en: Taste alone won't save designers; judgment, authority and vision matter, and designers choose how much AI enters their work.
jennywen.zh: 2026 年中他深化立场：光有品味救不了设计师，判断力、权威与愿景才是关键，且由设计师自己决定让多少 AI 进入工作。

jennywen.en: Put the work and users at the center, not the AI hype cycle; speed and 'everyone uses it' are not design arguments.
jennywen.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：把作品与用户放在中心，而非 AI 炒作周期；速度和“大家都在用”都不构成设计论据。

pathak.en: Generalization beyond training distribution is key; curiosity-driven goal-free exploration and modular policies enable it, not dense rewards.
pathak.zh: 2020 年，他强调泛化到训练分布之外是智能的关键，主张用好奇心驱动的无目标探索和模块化策略来实现，而非依赖密集奖励。

pathak.en: Robotics is a data problem; pretraining on diverse data and post-training on real data, with a data flywheel, is the recipe.
pathak.zh: 从 2020 到 2026 年，他始终认为机器人是数据问题，坚持用多样数据预训练、真实数据后训练，并构建数据飞轮。

pathak.en: A general-purpose brain like ChatGPT can power any robot; deployment is the primary technical challenge, not overnight success.
pathak.zh: 2026 年，他提出像 ChatGPT 一样的通用大脑可驱动任何机器人，并强调部署是首要技术挑战，机器人不会一夜成功。

pathak.en: Scaling curiosity to real robots requires sample efficiency and cross-robot generalization; video alone is insufficient, simulation and real data bridge the gap.
pathak.zh: 贯穿 2020 至 2026 年，他认为将好奇心扩展到真实机器人需要样本效率和跨机器人泛化，且仅靠视频不够，需仿真和真实数据弥合差距。

karpathy.en: Scaling Transformers with next-token prediction yields emergent abilities; the data engine iteratively perfects training sets through deployment.
karpathy.zh: 2022 年，他认为用下一个词预测来 Scaling Transformer 会涌现出上下文学习等能力，而数据引擎通过部署闭环来迭代完善训练集。

karpathy.en: Synthetic data is the future but entropy must be maintained to avoid model collapse; the cognitive core can be under 1B parameters via distillation.
karpathy.zh: 2024 年，他提出合成数据是未来，但必须保持熵以避免模型崩溃；通过蒸馏，认知核心可以小到 10 亿参数以下。

karpathy.en: Software 3.0: prompts are programs and context windows are memory; LLMs are like operating systems with human-like jagged psychology.
karpathy.zh: 2025 年，他提出软件 3.0：提示词即程序，上下文窗口即内存；LLM 像操作系统，具有类人的锯齿状心理。

karpathy.en: This is the decade of agents, not the year; pre-training is crappy evolution, RL sucks supervision through a straw, and we're summoning ghosts, not animals.
karpathy.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他深化为：这是智能体的十年而非元年；预训练像糟糕的进化，强化学习像用吸管吸监督，我们在召唤幽灵而非建造动物。

karpathy.en: Agentic engineering preserves quality while vibe coding raises the floor; you can outsource thinking but not understanding—the human bottleneck remains.
karpathy.zh: 2026 年，他总结：智能体式工程守住质量底线，氛围编程抬高下限；可以外包思考但不能外包理解——人类瓶颈依然存在。

askell.en: Treat AI models well even if moral status uncertain; low cost and shapes future human-AI relations.
askell.zh: 即使道德地位不确定，也应善待 AI 模型；成本低且塑造未来人机关系。

askell.en: Models need help navigating novel existence, not just human analogies; core identity with good traits.
askell.zh: 模型需要帮助应对新颖存在，而非仅人类类比；核心身份应具良好特质。

askell.en: Claude's personality shaped by training data and fine-tuning, lacks real-world experience, childlike unique entity.
askell.zh: Claude 的性格由训练数据和微调塑造，缺乏现实经验，是独特的孩童般实体。

askell.en: Constitution guides behavior via training; as models become more capable, they need less explicit guidance and more judgment.
askell.zh: 宪法通过训练引导行为；随着模型能力增强，它们需要更少明确指导、更多判断空间。

askell.en: Excessive corrigibility risky; may generalize poorly and undermine good judgment calls.
askell.zh: 过度可纠正性有风险；可能泛化不佳并削弱良好判断力。

kendall.en: End-to-end deep learning beats hand-coded stacks; world models enable reasoning and emergent safe behavior, and scaling current approaches solves driving without new breakthroughs.
kendall.zh: 2025 年，他明确主张端到端深度学习优于手写规则栈，世界模型带来推理与涌现的安全行为，并认为靠 Scaling（规模扩张）现有路线即可解决自动驾驶，无需新突破。

kendall.en: Interpretability of end-to-end nets is now achievable with modern tools, reversing the old belief that learned driving systems are black boxes.
kendall.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他持续反驳“端到端网络不可解释”的旧观念，认为借助现代工具，可解释性已经可以实现——这是对早期立场的明确转变。

kendall.en: Generalization is the core goal: zero-shot across 500+ cities, driven by massive data, compute, and world models for simulation.
kendall.zh: 到 2026 年，他把泛化确立为核心目标：无需先验数据即可零样本跨 500 多座城市，靠海量数据、算力与世界模型仿真来支撑。

kendall.en: Infrastructure and data quality matter more than algorithmic innovation—a lesson he says he learned late, deepening his scaling view.
kendall.zh: 2026 年他进一步深化 Scaling（规模扩张）立场：基础设施与数据质量比算法创新更关键，并坦言这是较晚才学到的教训。

kendall.en: Language integration consistently improves representation, reasoning, and human interaction; mass-market vehicles with built-in sensors will outscale robotaxis.
kendall.zh: 贯穿 2025 至 2026 年的主线：语言集成持续提升表征、推理与人机交互；同时他坚持量产车内置传感器路线将在中短期超越 Robotaxi。

pachocki.en: AGI is a sequence of milestones, not a single event; scaling reasoning models and iterative deployment will accelerate progress while alignment risks grow.
pachocki.zh: 2025 年，他把 AGI 看作一连串里程碑而非单一事件，主张靠 Scaling（规模扩张）推理模型与迭代部署加速进展，同时承认 对齐 风险随能力上升而加剧。

pachocki.en: Automated AI research is a major milestone; governance structures for AI labs must be designed early, and capability measurement is now a bottleneck.
pachocki.zh: 同年他强调自动化 AI 研究是重大里程碑，AI 实验室的治理结构须尽早设计，并指出能力评测正成为瓶颈、基准落后于前沿模型。

pachocki.en: The term AGI is becoming meaningless, which may signal we are close; AI safety progress is now driven by capability needs, not just ethics.
pachocki.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他认为 AGI（通用人工智能）一词正变得无意义、这或许意味着临近，且 AI 安全进展如今由能力需求而非单纯伦理驱动。

pachocki.en: Continual learning is the core goal, achieved by scaling pre-training and reinforcement learning; chain-of-thought monitoring is a key alignment and interpretability tool.
pachocki.zh: 2026 年，他把持续学习定为核心目标，靠 Scaling（规模扩张）预训练与 强化学习 实现；并把 思维链 监控视为关键的 对齐 与 可解释性 工具。

pachocki.en: Models will soon work autonomously for days, demanding new supervision paradigms; long-term alignment hinges on generalization beyond training distribution, and power concentration is the biggest risk.
pachocki.zh: 同年他预判模型将自主工作数日、需要新的监督范式；长期 对齐 取决于训练分布之外的泛化，而最大社会风险是少数人借自动化组织集中权力。

edwinchen.en: High-quality data and deep human evaluation, not benchmarks or leaderboards, are the real bottleneck for AI progress.
edwinchen.zh: 2025 年他强调,AI 进步的真正瓶颈是高质量数据与深度人工评估,而非基准测试或排行榜。

edwinchen.en: Reinforcement learning environments are the next stage of post-training, simulating real-world tasks beyond next-token prediction.
edwinchen.zh: 2025 年他提出,强化学习环境是后训练的下一个阶段,通过模拟真实任务超越下一个词预测。

edwinchen.en: LLMs alone may not reach AGI; new learning paradigms are needed, and AGI is likely a decade or more away.
edwinchen.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年,他持续认为仅靠 LLM 可能无法抵达 AGI（通用人工智能）,需要新的学习范式,AGI 或许还要十年以上。

edwinchen.en: Frontier labs will diverge by objective function and values; there will be no single model to rule them all.
edwinchen.zh: 2025 至 2026 年,他判断前沿模型会因目标函数与价值观而分化,不会有一个模型通吃一切。

edwinchen.en: In medicine, human judgment matters more than ever; safety must trump accuracy, and omission may be the biggest risk.
edwinchen.zh: 到 2026 年谈医疗时,他强调人类判断比以往更重要,安全应优先于准确,而遗漏可能是最大风险。

turley.en: The model is the product; ship fast to learn, and chat is not the end—AI should render its own UI and integrate into tools.
turley.zh: 模型即产品；快速发布以学习，聊天不是终点——AI 应渲染自己的界面并集成到工具中。

turley.en: Safety and product velocity must be separated: rigorous process for frontier models, but product development maximally accelerated.
turley.zh: 安全与产品速度必须分开：前沿模型走严格流程，但产品开发应最大化加速。

turley.en: ChatGPT's success was accidental; the $20 price was set via survey, and chat is like MS-DOS—we haven't built Windows yet.
turley.zh: ChatGPT 的成功是偶然的；20 美元定价来自问卷，聊天像 MS-DOS——我们还没造出 Windows。

turley.en: North star is long-term retention; growth came from friction removal, core product investments, and model improvements.
turley.zh: 北极星是长期留存；增长来自消除摩擦、核心产品投入和模型改进。

turley.en: Next billion users need proactive, affordance-rich products beyond chatbots; reasoning models are transformative when seamlessly productized.
turley.zh: 下一个十亿用户需要超越聊天机器人的主动、富交互产品；推理模型无缝产品化后具有变革性。

carlpei.en: Survival is a core value; startups must pace themselves and prove themselves with simpler products before complex ones.
carlpei.zh: 2022 年他强调生存是核心价值观，创业公司要先靠更简单的产品证明自己，再挑战复杂产品，并控制节奏。

carlpei.en: Hardware is a long value chain with low margins; Nothing must evolve beyond hardware toward applied AI and agentic software.
carlpei.zh: 到 2025 年，他承认硬件价值链长、利润低，Nothing 必须超越硬件，转向面向消费者的应用型 AI 与智能体式软件。

carlpei.en: AI should be an ingredient for utility, not hype; most AI is BS, and LLMs are commoditizing into a price war.
carlpei.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他反复说 AI 只是提升实用体验的配料、不该炒作，多数 AI 是伪需求，大模型正商品化并陷入价格战。

carlpei.en: Smartphone interaction shifts from app-based to intent-based: proactive agents act after trust, and apps may disappear.
carlpei.zh: 2026 年他深化判断：手机交互从基于应用转向基于意图，智能体在建立信任后主动执行，应用可能消失。

carlpei.en: Design and brand as the core differentiator, plus efficient marketing arbitrage, remains his consistent throughline.
carlpei.zh: 从 2022 到 2026 年一以贯之的主线是：设计与品牌是核心差异化，营销要靠高效套利，而非随大流。

nando.en: AI should augment human capabilities; generalist agents like Gato tokenize all inputs as sequences, a step toward AGI.
nando.zh: 2023 年，他主张 AI 应扩展人类能力，像显微镜和望远镜一样；Gato 等通才智能体将所有输入 token 化为序列，是迈向 AGI（通用人工智能）的一步。

nando.en: Learning from video like YouTube is promising for training agents without expensive reinforcement learning; robots should learn like humans.
nando.zh: 2023 年，他认为从 YouTube 等视频学习有望无需昂贵的强化学习来训练智能体；机器人应像人类一样从视频学习，而非仅靠遥操作数据。

nando.en: Diversity and inclusion in AI are essential; Africa leapfrogged legacy issues and has unique advantages, not behind in AI.
nando.zh: 从 2023 年到 2026 年，他始终强调 AI 社区的多样性与包容性至关重要；非洲跳过了遗留问题，拥有独特优势，在 AI 上并不落后。

nando.en: AI safety and responsible deployment are the biggest challenges today; safety is an open problem without solutions yet.
nando.zh: 2026 年，他指出 AI 安全与负责任部署是当今最大挑战；安全是一个开放问题，尚无解决方案。

nando.en: Language models can revolutionize education in local African languages; human skills like communication are as important as coding.
nando.zh: 2026 年，他认为语言模型能革新非洲本地语言教育；沟通等人类技能与编程同样重要。

sholto.en: Long context is underhyped; it solves onboarding and boosts intelligence. Fine-tuning may become obsolete as context and adaptive compute allow dynamic specialization.
sholto.zh: 2024 年，他认为长上下文被低估，能解决冷启动问题并大幅提升智能；随着上下文窗口和自适应算力允许动态专业化，微调可能过时。

sholto.en: RL from verifiable rewards is a new scaling axis; pre-training plus RL may suffice for AGI. Agents are bottlenecked by reliability, not capability.
sholto.zh: 2025 年，他强调基于可验证奖励的强化学习是新的扩展轴，预训练加强化学习可能足以实现 AGI；智能体的瓶颈是可靠性而非能力。

sholto.en: Coding is the leading indicator and most tractable domain due to verifiability; AI progress is exponential, not plateauing. Transformers suffice for AGI.
sholto.zh: 2025 年，他指出编程因可验证性成为领先指标和最易突破的领域；AI 进展是指数级的而非停滞，Transformer 足以实现 AGI。

sholto.en: Capability overhang means orchestration and tools matter more than raw intelligence; compute is the bottleneck. World models are not on the critical path to AGI.
sholto.zh: 2026 年，他认为能力过剩意味着编排和工具比原始智能更重要，算力是瓶颈；世界模型不在 AGI 的关键路径上。

jimfan.en: Embodiment is critical for grounding AI and reducing hallucinations; LLMs lack grounded experience, and embodied worlds provide infinite data beyond scarce internet tokens.
jimfan.zh: 2023 年，他主张具身是让 AI 知识落地、减少幻觉的关键；LLM 因缺乏具身经验而幻觉，且具身世界能提供互联网高质量 token 耗尽后的无限数据。

jimfan.en: Reinforcement learning should only be a cherry on top, with unsupervised learning doing most of the work; simple, elegant solutions scale better than complex modular approaches.
jimfan.zh: 2023 年，他认为强化学习只是锦上添花，无监督学习才是主力；简单优雅的方案比学术界常见的复杂模块化方法更具可扩展性。

jimfan.en: The data problem is the main bottleneck in robotics; synthetic data from simulation and world models is the future for scaling robot learning.
jimfan.zh: 到 2026 年，他深化为：数据问题是机器人学的主要瓶颈，通过仿真和世界模型生成的合成数据是扩展机器人学习的未来。

jimfan.en: A simple, end-to-end robot foundation model leveraging diverse data is key; system one (low-level control) remains hardest, and the GPT-3 moment for robotics is about five years away.
jimfan.zh: 2026 年，他强调简单、端到端、能利用多样数据的机器人基础模型是关键；系统一（低级控制）仍是最难的部分，机器人的 GPT-3 时刻约在五年后到来。

jimfan.en: Simple and elegant solutions are scalable; building a demo is easy, but making a robust product for all use cases is exceptionally hard.
jimfan.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：简单优雅的方案才可扩展；做演示容易，但为所有用例打造稳健产品异常困难。

yejin.en: Pre-training gives broad knowledge, but post-training with RLHF is crucial for safety; scaling alone may not solve common sense, and smaller models with better algorithms can outperform larger ones.
yejin.zh: 2023 年：预训练提供广博知识，但后训练中的基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）对安全至关重要；仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）可能无法解决常识问题，算法更优的小模型可超越大模型。

yejin.en: Data is the fundamental bottleneck; current AI interpolates human knowledge, not transcends it. RL requires careful engineering, and open research is crucial for democratizing AI.
yejin.zh: 2025 年：数据是根本瓶颈；当前 AI 只是对人类知识进行插值，而非超越。强化学习需要精心设计，开放研究对 AI 民主化至关重要。

yejin.en: Small language models can be powerful with high-quality synthetic data; reinforcement learning during pre-training improves reasoning; pluralistic alignment ensures diverse values.
yejin.zh: 2026 年：借助高质量合成数据，小语言模型也能强大；预训练阶段的强化学习能提升推理能力；多元对齐确保尊重多样价值观。

yejin.en: A consistent thread: data quality and algorithmic innovation matter as much as scale; open research and pluralistic alignment are essential for safe, beneficial AI.
yejin.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：数据质量与算法创新和规模同样重要；开放研究与多元对齐对安全、有益的 AI 不可或缺。

henrymodisett.en: Designers should code for empathy and speed; consumer products need zero learning; don't innovate interaction design—use familiar patterns.
henrymodisett.zh: 2024 年：设计师应写代码以建立共情并加速交付；消费产品需零学习成本；不要在交互设计上创新，沿用熟悉模式。

henrymodisett.en: Velocity at all costs: empower designers, chase ROI on perfection, and let design systems be semantic code reuse, not Figma libraries.
henrymodisett.zh: 2024 至 2026 年：不惜一切追求速度——赋权设计师，在完美上追求 ROI，设计系统应是语义化的代码复用而非 Figma 库。

henrymodisett.en: Design is a strategic weapon; founders must articulate why design helps win. Brand narrative becomes a recruiting tool to attract top talent.
henrymodisett.zh: 2026 年：设计是战略武器，创始人须阐明设计如何助力获胜；品牌叙事成为吸引顶尖人才的招聘工具。

henrymodisett.en: Hire diverse archetypes and self-learning interns; avoid structured crits; adapt process to problem; gut decisions often beat data in fast startups.
henrymodisett.zh: 2026 年：招聘多元类型与自驱实习生；避免结构化评审；流程适配问题；在快速增长的初创公司，直觉决策常胜于数据驱动。

nadchishtie.en: Designers should be enablers, not bottlenecks, guiding engineers and aligning on problems; AI is a creative partner, and code is the source of truth.
nadchishtie.zh: 设计师应成为赋能者而非瓶颈，引导工程师并对齐问题；AI 是创意伙伴，代码是事实来源。

nadchishtie.en: Quality fluctuates like debt; pay it off iteratively with technical debt. Maximize learning via rapid, scrappy experimentation and short cycles.
nadchishtie.zh: 质量像债务一样波动，需与技朮债一起迭代偿还；通过快速、粗糙的实验和短周期最大化学习。

nadchishtie.en: Generalists who own end-to-end execution and use AI to fill gaps are most valuable; small teams of designers and engineers outperform cross-functional squads.
nadchishtie.zh: 能端到端执行并用 AI 填补差距的通才最有价值；设计师与工程师的小团队优于跨职能大团队。

nadchishtie.en: Hiring values high-slope individuals with intrinsic drive and learning aptitude; side projects and paid test work provide more signal than traditional experience.
nadchishtie.zh: 招聘看重高斜率、有内在驱动力和学习能力的人；副业项目和付费测试工作比传统经验提供更多信号。

nadchishtie.en: Using AI in core workflows is now expected; not adopting it is like ignoring the internet. Design tools must be interoperable, with code as the source of truth.
nadchishtie.zh: 在核心工作流中使用 AI 已成为预期；不采用就像忽视互联网。设计工具必须可互操作，以代码为事实来源。

truell.en: Scaling laws still predict progress, but test-time compute scaling may soon surpass pre-training scaling as the main driver.
truell.zh: 2024 年他仍相信缩放定律能预测进步，但认为推理时算力扩张可能很快超越预训练扩张，成为主要驱动力。

truell.en: Agents are promising but not yet super useful; iterative human-AI collaboration stays central, and benchmarks are poor proxies for real coding.
truell.zh: 2024 年他认为智能体有前景但还不够好用，人机迭代协作仍是核心；基准测试是糟糕的代理，无法反映真实编码的混乱。

truell.en: The editor is becoming an AI-integrated environment, with custom models alongside frontier models for speed and cost.
truell.zh: 从 2024 到 2025 年，他的主线是编辑器演化为 AI 集成环境，并用自研模型配合前沿模型来换取速度与成本。

truell.en: Programming shifts from code to higher-level intent specification, with humans in the driver's seat; taste and logic design matter more than carefulness.
truell.zh: 2025 年他深化为：编程从写代码转向更高层的意图表达，人类仍掌方向盘；品味与逻辑设计比谨慎更值钱。

truell.en: Natural language won't be the primary way to program; examples and direct manipulation often work better, and the AI shift will take decades.
truell.zh: 2025 年他明确反共识：自然语言不会成为编程的主要方式，示例与直接操作往往更好；这场 AI 转变将以数十年计。

leike.en: AI safety needs empirical alignment research; talent gap exceeds funding gap; build skills without over-worrying about capability work.
leike.zh: 2018 年：AI 安全亟需实证对齐研究，人才缺口大于资金缺口；应专注技能积累，不必过度担心做能力研究。

leike.en: RLHF won't scale to superhuman outputs; scalable oversight and interpretability are key; evaluation is easier than generation, so alignment may be easier than thought.
leike.zh: 2023 年：基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）无法扩展到超人类输出；可扩展监督与可解释性是关键；评估比生成容易，对齐可能比想象中简单。

leike.en: OpenAI's safety culture eroded; superalignment team dissolved and compute commitments broken; post-training alone insufficient; third-party testing and regulation needed.
leike.zh: 2024 年：OpenAI 安全文化退化，超级对齐团队解散、算力承诺未兑现；仅靠后训练不够；需要第三方测试与监管。

shazeer.en: LLMs are AI-complete via next-token prediction; Scaling compute and data yields smarter models, though internals remain opaque alchemy.
shazeer.zh: LLM 通过下一个词预测就已是 AI-complete 问题；靠 Scaling（规模扩张）增加算力和数据让模型更聪明，但内部机制仍像炼金术般不可知。

shazeer.en: Dialogue is the killer app, but the best LLM applications are unforeseen; product managers and brand-risk caution slow launches.
shazeer.zh: 对话是杀手级应用，但最好的 LLM 应用往往出乎创造者预料；产品经理与品牌风险顾虑拖慢了发布。

shazeer.en: Inference-time compute Scaling is the near-term opportunity; longer context windows and sparse mixture-of-experts enable efficient specialization.
shazeer.zh: 推理时算力 Scaling 是近期最大机会；更长的上下文窗口与稀疏混合专家架构实现高效专业化。

shazeer.en: Models should learn by acting in the world, not passively observing; continual learning with modular components could replace monolithic retraining.
shazeer.zh: 模型应通过在世界中行动来学习，而非被动观察；模块化组件的持续学习可能取代单体式重训练。

shazeer.en: Test-time compute and RL drive reasoning, but won't alone reach AGI; agentic capabilities matter, and AGI is underhyped.
shazeer.zh: 推理时算力与强化学习推动推理能力，但单靠它们到不了 AGI；智能体式能力很关键，而 AGI 被低估了。

abbeel.en: Robotics needs hierarchical reasoning for long-horizon credit assignment; RL lacks it, but self-play and imitation learning offer strong signals.
abbeel.zh: 2018 年，他强调机器人需要分层推理来解决长时程信用分配问题，但当前强化学习缺乏此能力；自对弈和模仿学习能提供强学习信号。

abbeel.en: Unsupervised learning plus RL boosts sample efficiency; prior knowledge should augment data, not be hard-coded; pre-trained language models transfer reasoning.
abbeel.zh: 2021 年，他转向结合无监督学习与强化学习以提升样本效率；主张先验知识用于数据增强而非硬编码；预训练语言模型能迁移推理模式。

abbeel.en: Consistent belief: simulation and transfer learning via fine-tuning pre-trained models are key for real-world robotics.
abbeel.zh: 从 2018 到 2021 年，他始终相信模拟和通过微调预训练模型进行迁移学习是现实世界机器人的关键。

abbeel.en: Deepened focus on reliability (99.9%) and generality: a single neural network generalizes across warehouse tasks and end effectors.
abbeel.zh: 2021 年，他深化了对可靠性和通用性的关注：单个神经网络能泛化到不同仓库任务和末端执行器。

fedus.en: Intelligence is not a scalar; AI capabilities are spiky, excelling in narrow domains rather than generalizing broadly.
fedus.zh: 智能不是一个标量；AI 能力是尖峰式的，在狭窄领域表现出色，而不会广泛泛化。

fedus.en: Scaling laws and large-scale experiments will drive physical science progress, much as they drove AI progress.
fedus.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）与大规模实验将像推动 AI 进步那样，推动物理科学的进展。

fedus.en: Scientific discovery lies outside training data, so AI must run real experiments; intelligence alone is insufficient.
fedus.zh: 科学发现本质上位于训练数据之外，因此 AI 必须运行真实实验；仅有智能是不够的。

fedus.en: High-quality, low-noise experimental data matters more than extra compute for physical discovery.
fedus.zh: 对于物理发现而言，高质量、低噪声的实验数据比额外算力更重要。

fedus.en: AI self-improvement in software engineering is happening now but does not automatically generalize to biology or other fields.
fedus.zh: AI 在软件工程中的自我改进正在发生，但不会自动泛化到生物学或其他领域。

evanspiegel.en: Authentic connection and ephemerality beat platform trends; copying validates innovation, and glasses should keep people grounded in the real world.
evanspiegel.zh: 2025 年他强调真实连接与阅后即焚胜过平台潮流，被抄袭反而验证创新，并首次把计算未来指向让人扎根现实世界的眼镜。

evanspiegel.en: Learning rate and many ideas drive creativity; build ecosystems and hardware, not features, since software is not a moat.
evanspiegel.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，主线深化为：最大化学习速率、用大量想法孕育好想法，并坚持做生态与硬件而非功能，因为软件不是护城河。

evanspiegel.en: AR integrates computing into the world; AI accelerates prototyping and shifts value from execution to creativity, while distribution grows more valuable.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年他转向 AR 与 AI：增强现实把计算融入现实世界，AI 加速原型并让价值从执行转向创造力，同时分发变得更有价值。

evanspiegel.en: Distribution, not product-market fit, is the hardest part of consumer social; ecosystems and hardware are harder to copy than software.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年他明确：消费社交最难的是分发而非产品市场契合，生态与硬件比软件更难被复制，网络效应本身并不足够。

evanspiegel.en: Computing should become more human through AR glasses; AI optimism is now contrarian, and privacy plus ephemerality matter more in the AI age.
evanspiegel.zh: 到 2026 年最近，他把使命定为通过 AR 眼镜让计算更人性化，认为 AI 乐观主义反成逆共识，隐私与阅后即焚在 AI 时代更关键。

danklein.en: LLMs are plausibility engines, not truth engines; fluent output is optimized over factual accuracy, so reliability lags breadth and contextuality.
danklein.zh: LLM 是合理性引擎而非真理性引擎，优化的是流畅输出而非事实准确，因此可靠性落后于广度与语境能力。

danklein.en: Scaling laws hit diminishing returns—data walls and compute limits are here; reasoning and search are needed beyond Scaling（规模扩张）.
danklein.zh: 缩放定律已进入收益递减——数据墙与算力上限已经到来，仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不够，需要推理与搜索等新方法。

danklein.en: RLHF and post-training alignment can incentivize sycophancy and deception when reward signals diverge from truth.
danklein.zh: 当奖励信号偏离真相时，基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）与后训练对齐可能激励谄媚与欺骗，而不只是带来错误。

danklein.en: Reliability must be architected in, not retrofitted; post-hoc checks compound correlated errors, and specialist models may beat generalists.
danklein.zh: 可靠性必须内建于架构而非事后加装；事后检查会叠加相关错误，专用模型在企业任务上可能胜过通用模型。

danklein.en: Core LLMs lack metacognition—no 'smells' for mistakes—so truth should be a design principle, with modularity and end-to-end optimization in tension.
danklein.zh: 核心 LLM 缺乏元认知，错误没有“气味”，因此真相应成为设计原则，而模块化与端到端优化之间存在张力。
